Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

We are seeking a dynamic and hands-on Senior Manager to lead Anaplan’s Technical Content team – the group responsible for Anapedia (our product documentation), the Anaplan Planual (our modeling best-practice standard), documentation for the Anaplan Applications portfolio, and supporting disciplines such as localisation. This is a working manager role: you will lead a team of roughly 18 people organised into three sub-teams, while staying close enough to the content itself to set direction, raise the bar, and jump in where it matters.

The ideal candidate is not satisfied with how technical content has “always been done.” You will be expected to question established processes, modernise our content operations, and champion the use of AI technologies to scale content creation, maintenance, and localisation – without compromising the accuracy and trust our customers place in Anapedia and the Planual.

Your Impact

  • Set the Direction: Own & drive the vision and strategy for Anaplan’s technical content function, spanning Anapedia, the Planual, Anaplan Applications documentation, and localisation, and translate that vision into a clear, prioritised roadmap.
  • Lead a Multi-Team Organisation: Lead, coach, and develop a ~15-person organization structured across two sub-teams, building strong second-line leadership and a culture of ownership, quality, and continuous improvement.
  • Challenge the Status Quo: Actively challenge the status quo in how technical content is planned, produced, and maintained – retiring processes that no longer serve the business and introducing better ones, even when that means disrupting familiar ways of working.
  • Scale Content with AI: Identify and implement AI-powered tools and workflows to accelerate content creation, review, updating, and translation, increasing both the velocity and consistency of our documentation at scale.
  • Modernize the Content Stack: Evaluate, select, and evolve the content management systems and tooling that underpin Anapedia, the Planual, and our localisation pipeline, ensuring the team works with modern, fit-for-purpose platforms.
  • Lead as a Practitioner: Stay close to the work: contribute directly to complex or high-visibility content, model editorial standards, and provide hands-on guidance to sub-team leads and writers.
  • Partner Cross-Functionally: Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, UX, and Support to ensure technical content keeps pace with new releases, platform capabilities, and the Anaplan Applications roadmap.
  • Drive Localisation: Own the roadmap and operating model for translating and localising technical content, ensuring quality and consistency across languages and markets.
  • Measure What Matters: Define and track metrics for content quality, coverage, freshness, and efficiency, and use them to continuously improve how the team operates.

Your Qualifications

Required:

  • Proven experience managing a mid-size team (roughly 15–25 people), ideally including a nested or multi-team structure with team leads reporting to you.
  • Strong track record of setting up, maintaining, and scaling technical content operations – documentation, knowledge bases, or similar content at enterprise scale.
  • Hands-on familiarity with AI technologies applied to content creation, editing, quality assurance, or localisation, and a clear point of view on how to use them responsibly to increase efficiency.
  • Solid working knowledge of modern content management systems and documentation tooling (e.g., component content management systems, docs-as-code platforms, or similar).
  • A demonstrated bias toward challenging existing processes and driving change, balanced with the judgment to protect content quality and customer trust.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to operate confidently with senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, and Support.
  • Willingness to work in a hybrid model with occasional in-office days in the Manchester or York area, UK.

Desired:

  • Knowledge of enterprise planning, EPM, or connected planning software is a strong plus.
  • Experience running or scaling a localization/translation program for technical content.
  • Background in SaaS or enterprise software documentation, including experience with API, application, or platform documentation.

Description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200 colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring an Information Systems Architect to define the best practice in infrastructure as code at a global scale. Join us to advance the state of the art, and shape the infrastructure behind tens of millions devices running Ubuntu.

The Information Systems (IS) team is responsible for all IT operations at Canonical, including the infrastructure for building, packaging and distributing Ubuntu globally. As the IS architect, you will own the design of hardware and software implementation from PCI lanes to CDN and everything in between. Our goal is to be a reference operation, using the latest capabilities in Ubuntu and open source more generally, with the most modern operating principles. Your choices will impact the Ubuntu user experience for millions of users, and drive how Canonical’s engineers engage with compute and network resources in a devops setting.

As the IS Architect, you’ll be in a unique position to improve Canonical products and the open-source technologies they’re based on. You do this by leading System Reliability Engineers (SRE) and Data Center Engineers (DCE) to embrace best practices, and make informed decisions on technology choices in all aspects of cloud infrastructure and services. You will coach the IS team on automation, reliability, operational/technical scalability, network infrastructure and security.

This is a home based position, with twice-annual travel to company events totaling around 4 weeks per year.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region

The role entails

  • Define, get buy-in and implement the holistic vision of a world class internal cloud
  • Setup, maintain and update the technical design roadmap and guidelines for the SREs within IS, with the aim of improving reliability, resilience, operational scalability, and technical scalability
  • Collaborate with, and provide the cloud-ops software development teams with input for roadmap, requirements and prioritization to build a world-class, highly standardized and automated operation
  • Provide the IS management with input and advice with regards to technology, reliability, resilience and business cases
  • Lead technical choices to implement solutions as self-service products, ensuring scalable operation
  • Collaborate with product security as well as operations security to set best practice and mitigate new threats in a timely manner
  • Automate operations for reuse across the world's largest companies, taking into consideration the complexities of distributed systems
  • Collaborate with development teams to design service architecture, documentation, playbooks, policies and operational procedures
  • Analyze incidents and events, and establish what the reason behind the reasons are, and what structural improvements can be made to minimize the chance of them reoccurring

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Extensive knowledge of cloud computing concepts, technologies & operation
  • Practical knowledge of Linux networking, routing, and firewalls, internet transit and large scale/bandwidth networking.
  • Experience dealing with significant production outages, incident response and postmortems
  • A passion for writing, sharing, and maintaining enterprise open-source software solutions
  • Able to communicate clearly and effectively in English over email, chat, video or voice calls and in-person
  • Be familiarized and passionate about open-source, especially Ubuntu or Debian

Description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Lisbon, Portugal 

About the Role: 

Do you love solving complex problems and interacting with people? Are you passionate about helping customers and are a standout colleague? Cloudflare is seeking a Technical Customer Support Engineer to join our team. You will work with our customers on a variety of technical support issues as well as the Technical Operations team that is responsible for running our global distributed network. This is a position where you will learn the inner workings of Cloudflare's technology and gain a deeper understanding of internet technologies. You will focus on providing support on our Developer Platform products: Workers, Workers AI, Pages, KV, Stream, R2, D1, DO etc.

Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience:

  • You are familiar with Developer Platform products
  • You have previous experience working as part of a team in a customer-facing role
  • You have experience solving HTTP, DNS and other networking-related problems
  • You have experience with a common web development language (for example, Javascript)
  • You understand how the Internet works
  • You have experience working in a support role where you thrived every time you resolved a ticket
  • You are comfortable communicating through various support channels and always put the customer first  (Emails, Live Chats, Phone calls and  virtual meetings)
  • You are a motivated self-starter and always looking to expand your existing skill set

Bonus Points

  • You are fluent in German, Japanese, French, Spanish, Portuguese or Mandarin
  • You are familiar with Cloudflare and have a site actively using our platform
  • You have a solid grasp of problem-solving with command line tools (curl/dig/traceroute/tcpdump)
  • You are familiar with Nginx, Apache, IIS or any other web servers
  • You are committed to gaining a deeper understanding of the following technologies: DNS /  CDN - Cache / SSL / Cloudflare Workers
  • You have worked with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MS SQL or other database servers
  • You have experience with Cloudflare Workers and/or JavaScript 
  • You have experience with Video encoding and streaming solutions

 

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

  • For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary of €37,000-51,000. 

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Job summary

DigiCert is seeking a Technical Content Strategist to work at the intersection of product change, industry evolution, and customer impact. In this role, you will translate complex information into clear, trusted guidance that enables Validation and Technical Support teams to operate with confidence. You will shape how knowledge is created, structured, governed, measured, and reused across the organization. What you will do

  • Anticipate and Respond to Change
    • Identify, assess, and document current business processes while acting as an early signal for upcoming product, regulatory, policy, and industry changes.

    • Establish sustainable content-maintenance practices, including clear ownership, review cycles, version control, and retirement criteria.
  • Validate, Test, and Strengthen Processes
    • Test and verify new or updated processes using realistic scenarios to confirm accuracy, completeness, and usability before publication.
    • Facilitate reviews with Product, Validation, Operations, Compliance, Support, and other relevant stakeholders, resolving conflicting input and documenting approved outcomes.

Description: Are you excited about using AI and generative content tools to research, create, edit, optimize, repurpose, and scale high-quality technical content while applying strong editorial judgment to ensure quality, accuracy, and originality? If you answered “Yes,” then read on! As a Content Strategist & Editor at Educative, you will help develop and execute content strategy across Educative’s websites, microsites, community platforms, and external publishing channels. This is not a traditional writing or copy-editing role. We are looking for someone who can combine strategic thinking, strong editorial judgment, technical content expertise, marketing, and execution. You will be expected to think through the strategy, build the right approach, and execute initiatives end to end—from research and ideation to content creation, editorial refinement, publishing, distribution, measurement, and optimization. As Educative increasingly leverages AI to scale content production, you will also play a critical editorial role in ensuring that AI-assisted content meets a high quality bar. This means going beyond grammar and proofreading to fact-check, research, restructure, rewrite, improve storytelling, identify content gaps, and ensure that every piece provides genuine value to the user. A Computer Science or other technical background is a strong plus, as this role sits at the intersection of technical content and marketing. You will work across content strategy, editorial, AEO/GEO, SEO, storytelling, competitive intelligence, AI-assisted content production, automation, and execution. In this role, you will be responsible for: Develop and execute content strategies across Educative’s websites, microsites, community platforms, and external publishing channels. Think strategically about what content we should create, why we should create it, who it is for, how it should be distributed, and how we can scale it. Conduct user, market, search, and competitor research to identify content gaps, emerging opportunities, and areas where Educative can build authority. Analyze competitor topics, formats, messaging, publishing strategies, SEO approaches, editorial quality, and distribution channels. Translate research and competitive insights into actionable content strategies, editorial priorities, content briefs, and new initiatives. Research, create, edit, optimize, and publish technical blogs, newsletters, landing pages, guides, and other short- and long-form content. Use GPT, Claude, and other generative AI tools for research, ideation, drafting, editing, optimization, repurposing, and scaling content production. Help build and continuously improve Educative’s AI-assisted content production and editorial workflows. Serve as the editorial layer for AI-generated content, ensuring increased content output does not come at the expense of quality. Substantially improve AI-generated and human-written content through research, fact-checking, restructuring, rewriting, editing, and human judgment. Review content for technical accuracy, depth, originality, clarity, structure, readability, search intent, and overall user value. Identify outdated information, factual inaccuracies, weak explanations, content gaps, unsupported claims, repetition, and opportunities to make content more useful and differentiated. Determine when content can be efficiently produced or scaled using AI and when it requires original research, technical expertise, human judgment, or storytelling. Develop and maintain editorial standards and guidelines for AI-assisted and human-created content. Shape headlines, introductions, narratives, examples, CTAs, and overall content structure to make technical content more engaging and effective. Develop compelling stories and narratives around technology, software development, AI, education, and Educative’s products. Develop user-focused landing page and marketing copy that clearly communicates value, addresses user needs, drives engagement, and supports conversion. Apply SEO best practices, including keyword research, search intent analysis, content optimization, internal linking, topical coverage, and content structure. Develop and optimize content for AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) as search and content discovery increasingly move beyond traditional search engines. Experiment with new content formats, publishing platforms, distribution channels, and AI-powered content workflows. Identify opportunities to repurpose and distribute content across blogs, newsletters, Medium, Substack, DEV Community, microsites, and other relevant channels. Manage content across multiple publishing accounts while maintaining consistent brand positioning, messaging, voice, and editorial quality. Monitor content performance and use data, audience insights, search trends, and competitive intelligence to continuously improve content initiatives. Contribute to editorial calendars and manage initiatives from strategy and ideation through execution, publishing, distribution, measurement, and optimization. Collaborate with SEO, marketing, product, engineering, and subject-matter experts to create content aligned with both user needs and business objectives. Take ownership of projects and proactively identify opportunities rather than waiting for predefined assignments. About you: 1–3 years of experience in content marketing, technical content, content strategy, editorial, SEO, or a related field. Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or another technical background is a strong plus. Strong combination of strategic thinking, editorial judgment, research, and execution skills. Exceptional research, editing, and writing skills, with the ability to substantially improve content rather than simply proofread it. Ability to understand complex technical concepts and communicate them in clear, accessible, and engaging ways. Strong understanding of what makes content accurate, useful, differentiated, well-structured, and valuable to the target audience. Ability to think strategically about content while also being comfortable executing the work yourself. Experience using GPT, Claude, and other generative AI tools for content research, creation, editing, optimization, or workflow automation. Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated content and apply strong human editorial judgment to improve its quality. Working understanding of SEO best practices and search intent; experience using SEO tools is a plus. Familiarity with AEO/GEO and AI-powered search experiences is a strong plus. Strong understanding of content strategy, storytelling, content distribution, and audience research. Ability to conduct competitor and market research and translate findings into actionable strategies. Comfortable experimenting with AI-powered workflows, automation, and new content production processes. Meticulous eye for detail and high standards for content quality. Curious, growth-minded, and eager to learn about emerging technologies and changes in the content and search landscape. Self-starter who takes ownership and can independently take an initiative from strategy → approach → execution → optimization. Passion for technology, education, learning, and helping people build technical skills. Interested in the latest trends and developments in technology, software development, AI, and developer behavior. Programming experience or familiarity with coding concepts is a major plus.   • Experience with accessibility and inclusive content design

  • Experience working with localization or designing content for global audiences

Senior Technical Product Manager, API Traffic and Enforcement

APIs are how software talks to software, and the volume and variety of that traffic is growing rapidly. AI agents now discover and call APIs directly, and MCP servers are a new kind of endpoint with the same questions attached: what exists, what it's supposed to do, and who is allowed to call it. Enterprises are challenged to respond to those questions. This role owns Fastly's answer.

As a Senior Technical Product Manager on Fastly's Core Infrastructure Product Management team, you will own how Fastly defines what traffic is allowed and how traffic is held to that definition. That means our customers' API surface end to end – discovery and inventory of the APIs they actually run, the schemas that describe intended behavior, and the API gateway itself – and the enforcement primitives underneath it, including ACLs, allowlists, rate limiting, and the request-path controls that turn a declared model into something the platform actually enforces. Much of security is about detecting the bad. Your charter is the other half: defining what good looks like and enforcing it.

Customer APIs are the first and largest surface for the positive model, and the primitives you own are the ones other products adopt as that model extends across the platform. This role reports to the Director of Core Infrastructure Product Management and has real latitude to set direction.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the positive model end to end: drive the strategy and roadmap for defining what traffic is allowed. You will take customers from not knowing what APIs they run, to describing intended behavior precisely, to enforcing it in the request path.
  • Make API discovery tell customers something they didn't know: own discovery and inventory across the API surfaces customers actually operate. Discovery is where most customers start, and how good it is determines whether they trust anything built on top of it.
  • Turn schemas into enforceable contracts: own schema definition, generation, and validation. When customers can't hand you an accurate spec for their own APIs, the product has to produce one worth enforcing against, then keep it accurate as their APIs change.
  • Own enforcement in the request path: ACLs, allowlists, rate limiting, and the controls that turn a declared model into something the platform enforces, along with the gateway that applies them. Build these as primitives other products can adopt, not features scoped to one surface.
  • Make agents first-class: agents calling APIs are a new kind of client, and MCP servers are a new kind of endpoint. Define how Fastly identifies them, authorizes them, and holds them to allowed behavior.
  • Take and defend clear positions: bring evidence-based points of view on how traffic should be described and constrained, and drive them to decisions across engineering, product, and partner teams. You will bring structure to ambiguous problems and move decisions forward earlier.

What We're Looking For: 

  • Experience: 5+ years in product management or technical product leadership, ideally on API, security, or platform infrastructure products.
  • API and request-path fluency: you understand how API traffic is described, validated, and constrained — schemas and specs, gateway behavior, and the difference between allowlist models and detection-based ones. You can reason about where each fits and what it costs to run.
  • Platform thinking: a track record of building capabilities that serve more than one product or team. Shared primitives, enforcement points, or controls others build on, rather than features scoped to a single surface.
  • Execution focus: a demonstrated bias for shipping. You are hands-on and comfortable owning outcomes in ambiguous, fast-moving conditions rather than waiting for perfect clarity.
  • Conviction and influence: the ability to form clear, evidence-based positions and defend them across engineering and product partners, including pushing back constructively. You build alignment without relying on authority.
  • Communication and presentation: a clear communicator who can move between deep technical discussion with engineers and crisp framing for customers and executives, with genuine curiosity about the "why" behind a customer's problem. You can stand up in front of a room, make a case, and hold it under questioning.

We’ll be super impressed if you have experience in any of these: 

  • Hands-on work with API gateways and OpenAPI-driven validation: schema generation from live traffic, drift detection as APIs change, and the gap between the spec a team publishes and what their API actually does.
  • The agentic traffic stack — workload and agent identity (SPIFFE/WIMSE, mTLS), OAuth 2.1 for delegated agent authorization, and agent protocols like MCP and its authorization spec.
  • Request-path enforcement at scale: WASM filters, eBPF, or policy engines like OPA and Rego.
  • Startup or 0-to-1 experience building API, security, or infrastructure products in a fast-moving environment.

Work Hours: This position will require you to be available during core business hours. 

Work Location(s) & Travel Requirements: 

This position is open to Hybrid And Remote Work Locations.

The preferred locations for this position are:

  • San Francisco, CA

Fastly currently embraces a largely hybrid model for most roles which allows employees flexibility to split their time between the office and home.

Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences. 

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

Ready to be part of the experience?

Meet The Team 
Secret Media Network is a digital media group focused on recommending perfect plans, discovering great places, sharing things to do, and relevant breaking news in different cities around the world. Our network is composed of Secret London, Secret Chicago, Secret LA, Secret NYC, Secret Sydney, Lisboa Secreta, Paris Secret, Madrid Secreto, Barcelona Secreta, and More!

The Role
We are seeking an experienced Editorial Executive to lead the creation of compelling content for our media outlets for our expansion into new markets. Reporting directly to our VP of Media, you will play a pivotal role in managing a growing team of passionate editors, writers, video producers, and social media creatives. 

What You´ll Do

  • Scope of responsibility for the French and Belgian markets.
  • 1-on-1 management, ensuring clear workflows, and providing individual feedback.
  • Crafting, communicating, and executing a creative vision for the entire Secret Media Network.
  • Collaborating with Editors, Staff Writers, and the video and social team to establish and maintain high editorial standards, adhering to the brand’s identity and tone of voice.
  • Leading and guiding the team to foster growth, inspire creativity, and reach new audiences.
  • Working with experienced editors to elevate our content in established cities, with an eye toward expandable formats.
  • Analyzing data for cities in your region based on SMN’s internal KPIs, and leveraging findings to inform future strategy.
  • Identifying editorial partnership opportunities to broaden SMN content to a diverse audience.
  • Taking a hands-on approach to initiate key content-creation initiatives.
  • You will also be responsible for coordinating, assigning, and prioritizing editorial work within the team, collaborating with other Fever departments, and developing and analyzing audience-growth strategies. Your role will involve celebrating 'wins' and sharing best practices network-wide.
  • Having a deep understanding of how the business operates and translating that knowledge into content strategies that support revenue, audience growth, and overall company objectives.
  • Building and optimizing a successful content-driven conversion funnel, ensuring that storytelling, formats, distribution, and audience insights work together to drive measurable conversions.

Who You Are

  • Proficiency in English and bilingual/native level in French.
  • +5 years of experience working for a newsroom, content agency, creative agency, or digital media property.
  • Strong leadership skills with a minimum of 2 years of team management experience.
  • Deep passion for journalism, especially at the local level, social media, and digital marketing.
  • Expertise in media mapping and the ability to collaborate with external partners (advertising agencies, media agencies, TV/Animation companies).
  • Digital fluency and hands-on knowledge of the current social media landscape, including platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, X, etc.
  • Ability to inspire creative teams and customers, strong presentation skills.
  • Data-driven and business-savvy with superb writing skills and creative flair.
  • Solid understanding of optimization technologies and AI-driven processes, workflow automation, and performance outcomes.
  • Ability to convert content creators' economy into growth opportunities.
  • Team player attitude.
  • Additionally, proficiency in using WordPress, familiarity with Photoshop, Canva, and knowledge of other image/video editing software is preferred. Powerful media network contacts and connections will be highly appreciated.

Why You´ll Love It Here

  • Attractive compensation package with room to grow.
  • 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences + free Candlelight voucher.
  • Flexible remuneration with Cobee: meals, transport, training, and nursery support (tax-exempt).
  • Payflow: option to access part of your salary in advance.
  • Taxdown: help optimizing and filing your taxes.
  • Private health & dental insurance with Cigna: 100% covered by Fever. You can also add your family members via flexible remuneration.
  • Wellhub membership for gym and wellness access: 100% covered by Fever up to the Silver plan.
  • Language learning support: English and Spanish lessons.
  • Hybrid work setup: home office friendly with a central Madrid office location.
  • Snacks, drinks, and fresh fruit are always available at the office.
  • Dynamic international team: a young, talented group creating a great work environment.

 

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

Description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us


Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Staff Technical Writer to write and edit enterprise documentation that empowers our customers to use Fivetran and understand how our data warehouse, database, and data lake products work. You’ll collaborate with engineers, product managers, support engineers, and other technical writers. You join a friendly team of technical writers distributed among our international offices.

This is a full-time position based out of our Bangalore office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team.

Technologies You’ll Use

  • Documentation-as-code tools, including Markdown, Git, GitHub, and CI/CD workflows
  • Data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, and BigQuery
  • Cloud storage services such as Amazon S3, ADLS, and GCS
  • Collaboration and project management tools such as Jira and Slack

What You’ll Do

  • Create and maintain clear, accurate product documentation and release notes that help customers succeed.
  • Review and refine customer-facing content, including error messages and UI text.
  • Use a docs-as-code approach to co-author documentation with engineers, product managers, and contributors across the company.
  • Improve existing documentation by ensuring technical accuracy, clarity, and consistency.
  • Collaborate with a global writing team to define and evolve documentation standards, style, and terminology.
  • Partner with engineers, SMEs, and cross-functional teams to deliver best-in-class technical documentation.
  • Contribute to style guides, templates, and other shared resources that raise the bar for all company content.
  • Act as a writing resource for other teams, helping improve content quality across the organization.

Skills We’re Looking For

  • Extensive expertise in data warehouse and data lake documentation: 8+ years of experience documenting data warehouses, databases, data lakes, and cloud applications for a US-centric audience. 
  • Deep technical knowledge: Experience with complex data lake and data warehouse technologies, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), data pipelines (ETL/ELT), and replication techniques.
  • Scripting, automation, and AI proficiency: Skilled at leveraging scripting, automation, and AI tools to streamline documentation workflows and enhance technical content delivery.
  • Exceptional communication skills: Proven ability to craft clear, concise, and accurate documentation; strong technical editing abilities; impeccable grammar; and consistent application of style guides.
  • Documentation leadership: Expertise in content planning, creation, and review processes, with a track record of implementing best practices that elevate documentation quality.
  • Project management and organizational skills: Experience leading documentation projects, mentoring writers, managing competing priorities, and adapting to change while delivering high-quality results.
  • Collaboration and customer focus: Strong history of working with engineers, writers, and globally distributed teams, translating customer needs into improved documentation that drives customer success.

Bonus Skills​

  • Experience working at technology companies with globally distributed technical writing teams documenting enterprise-grade products or services.
  • Understanding of the nuances of complex documentation lifecycles and experience working in an Agile environment.
  • Experience working in a docs-as-code environment, GitHub, Markdown, CLI, and HTML.
  • Understanding of cloud object storage, metadata catalogs such as AWS Glue and Unity Catalog, and open table formats such as Apache Iceberg and Delta Lake.
  • Experience documenting configuration and deployment workflows for containerization and orchestration platforms such as Docker, Podman, and Kubernetes.

  • Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.

About This Role: 

The Senior Digital Experience & Content Designer is a hybrid designer who combines user-centered design thinking, digital content creation, and visual design to create personalized experiences for consumers across digital touchpoints.

This role focuses on understanding users, their needs, behaviors, and where they are in their customer journey, then translating those insights into relevant, on-brand communications and experiences. The designer will create content across email, push notifications, content cards, personalization, rewards, promotions, websites, applications, and other digital touchpoints.

Sitting between traditional UX design and art direction, this person brings a UX mindset to audience needs and journeys while also having the hands-on visual design skills to create polished digital content. They will work across multiple brands and audiences, adapting creative and messaging based on what is most relevant to each user.


What You'll Do:

  • Personalized Digital Content & Engagement

    • Design digital communications across email, push notifications, content cards, personalized experiences, rewards, promotions, and other engagement channels.
    • Translate user journeys, audience segments, behavioral data, and consumer insights into relevant content and visual experiences.
    • Tailor messaging and creative based on where users are in their journey and their specific needs, behaviors, or interests.
    • Develop content that supports ongoing customer engagement, retention, loyalty, and relationship-building.
    • Adapt creative across multiple brands, maintaining each brand's visual identity while addressing different audience needs.
    • Partner with marketing, product, content, research, and technology partners to determine the right message, creative approach, and digital touchpoint for each audience.

  • Experience Strategy and UX/UI Design 

    • Work on the end-to-end front-end experience for connected digital touchpoints. 
    • Translate consumer needs, business requirements, brand objectives and content priorities into intuitive journeys, information architecture, interaction patterns and polished user interfaces. 
    • Create user flows, journey maps, wireframes, prototypes, page layouts and high-fidelity designs that clearly communicate experience and design intent as needed.

About the role

Glean is looking for a Content Systems Engineer to own the documentation experience for our connectors—the integrations that allow Glean to securely access knowledge across our customers’ systems.

Connector documentation serves technical administrators responsible for configuring access, authentication, permissions, and deployments within their organizations. Keeping this information complete and accurate across a rapidly evolving product requires more than traditional authoring. It requires scalable systems that can detect change, generate and validate content, surface risk, and prevent documentation from drifting away from the product.

In this role, you will combine technical-writing expertise with programming, information architecture, and advanced AI practices. You will build deterministic automation and agentic workflows that improve documentation freshness and accuracy while reducing repetitive manual work. You will remain accountable for the quality of the resulting customer experience—not merely for producing content.

This is an AI-first documentation role. You will use AI to analyse complex inputs, generate and transform content, identify gaps, and support maintenance at scale. You will provide the judgment, technical understanding, evaluation systems, and guardrails needed to ensure that those systems produce accurate, useful, and trustworthy results.

The systems and practices you establish for connector documentation will also help improve quality across Glean’s broader documentation set.

You will:

  • Own the end-to-end quality, organization, and maintenance of Glean’s connector documentation.
  • Develop a deep understanding of how Glean’s connectors work, including their configuration, authentication, permissions, deployment, and troubleshooting requirements.
  • Build and maintain scripts, agents, and content pipelines that automate documentation creation, transformation, validation, and maintenance.
  • Design reusable AI workflows that combine appropriate models, tools, product context, instructions, and human review.
  • Create evaluations and guardrails for AI-generated and AI-maintained documentation, investigate failures, and improve the context, tools, prompts, and systems that shape output quality.
  • Build deterministic checks that detect stale, inconsistent, incomplete, or inaccurate documentation.
  • Establish an information architecture that helps technical administrators navigate complex setup and configuration flows.
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, QA, Support, field teams, and customers to understand product behavior, identify documentation risks, and prioritize improvements.
  • Define and track measures of documentation health, including freshness, accuracy, automated-check coverage, manual effort, and field or support complaints.
  • Apply successful tools, standards, and quality systems from the connector domain to the broader Glean documentation practice.

About you:

  • Prior professional experience of 8-10 Years creating or maintaining technical documentation for a complex software product.
  • A bachelor’s degree in computer science, technical communication, engineering, or another relevant field.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently build, debug, test, and maintain useful scripts, agents, automations, or content pipelines.
  • Strong proficiency in at least one programming language, preferably Python, TypeScript, or JavaScript.
  • Experience with docs-as-code or software-development workflows, including Git, GitHub, command-line tools, code review, and CI/CD.
  • Advanced practical experience using AI beyond one-off content generation, such as:
  • Strong knowledge of technical-writing and content-design principles, including audience analysis, information architecture, task-oriented documentation, and progressive disclosure.
  • The judgment to organize large amounts of ambiguous or conflicting information without producing unverified or low-quality content.
  • The ability to learn a technically complex product deeply and explain how it works with authority.
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively with engineers, product managers, QA, support teams, field teams, and other subject-matter experts.
  • A customer-focused approach to evaluating documentation quality and prioritizing improvements.
  • Willingness and ability to work on-site full time in Glean’s Bangalore office.
  • Recent professional experience in software development, test automation, or quality assurance.
  • Experience building automated tests or content-quality checks with tools such as Playwright.
  • Experience documenting enterprise software, APIs, authentication systems, permissions models, integrations, or administrative workflows.
  • Familiarity with API specifications and structured documentation sources, including OpenAPI.
  • Experience working directly with customers or conducting structured customer research.
  • Experience defining service-level objectives or other measurable standards for documentation freshness and accuracy.

Who we are

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. 

The role

As Systems Technical Writer, you will own the creation and maintenance of technical documentation across Helsing's multidisciplinary drone hardware and software programmes. Working directly with mechanical, electrical, software and aerodynamics engineers, you will extract first-principles technical knowledge from complex system architectures and translate it into precise, structured documentation used by both internal engineering teams and external operators. Your work ensures that the integrity of engineering intent is preserved from system requirement through to end-user procedure, directly supporting programme maturation, compliance and operational readiness. 

The day-to-day

  • Author and maintain high-quality technical publications including Interface Control Documents, System Architecture Descriptions, Operator Manuals and Maintenance Guides, drawing on direct analysis of CAD assemblies, electrical schematics, software APIs and aerodynamic test data 

  • Document physical, electrical and logical integration interfaces, including wire harnesses, pinouts and signal telemetry protocols, working in close collaboration with electronics and software engineers to ensure accuracy and traceability

Description:
You care about developer tools, clear technical storytelling, and helping software engineers do their best work. You know how to take complex product capabilities and turn them into clear narratives, launches, and campaigns that resonate with a highly technical audience. If you thrive on autonomy, take pride in your technical craft, and want to help shape how .NET developers worldwide view our tools, this role is for you.

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

Developer tools are changing fast, and how we talk about .NET tools needs to stay grounded, credible, and clear. We need someone who can take ownership of technical product marketing across Rider, ReSharper, and dotUltimate, ensuring our messaging cuts through industry noise and focuses on genuine developer needs.

In this role, you’ll dig into products and developer workflows yourself, identify the stories worth telling, and help determine how we bring them to market. You will work closely with Product Managers, software engineers, Developer Advocates, Research, Growth, and other Marketing teams. Decisions here live close to the work – you’ll have the autonomy to generate ideas, test new campaign approaches, and shape product messaging without needing permission at every step.

Day to day, you will:

  • Develop clear positioning, messaging, and product stories around Rider, ReSharper, dotUltimate, and related .NET developer experiences.
  • Turn complex technical capabilities and developer workflows into clear content, including launch stories, product pages, blog posts, case studies, video scripts, and campaign assets.
  • Own product and feature marketing for key capabilities, working from product priorities and product manager input to shape developer-facing stories.
  • Coordinate selected release marketing workflows, including planning and producing What’s New content and ensuring release stories are accurately represented.
  • Build a deep understanding of .NET developers, their workflows, customer needs, market trends, and community conversations to shape priorities and campaigns.
  • Develop and execute developer-focused campaigns around important product bets, defining the audience, message, channels, assets, and measures of success.
  • Extend product stories beyond release day through follow-up content, campaigns, customer stories, and amplification.
  • Measure the performance of launches, content, and campaigns, share what we learn, and adjust our approach when needed.
  • Help tell the evolving story of professional developer tools as AI changes how software is built, including workflows involving agents and code intelligence.
  • Contribute hands-on by writing articles, testing features, building briefs, editing landing pages, and capturing product visuals directly on demo projects.

What you’ll bring

  • High technical curiosity and a deep respect for developer workflows and software craft.
  • Comfort taking ownership, making decisions independently, and carrying ambiguous opportunities through execution.
  • A habit of asking good questions and challenging assumptions constructively before building a campaign.
  • Clear, direct communication style with an ability to explain complex technical ideas clearly and credibly.
  • Strong organizational skills to manage multiple workstreams and collaborate smoothly across distributed teams.
  • A pragmatic approach that balances strategic thinking, creative problem-solving, and hands-on execution.

What you’ll need

  • Practical experience in technical product marketing, developer marketing, or a comparable role for a technical software product.
  • Ability to understand software development well enough to work directly with engineers and translate technical capabilities into developer benefits.
  • Proven track record of bringing software products, features, or releases to market within frequent release cycles.
  • Solid understanding of positioning, messaging, audience segmentation, channel selection, and campaign measurement.
  • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to create compelling technical content and collaborate effectively with global teams.

We’d be especially thrilled if you:

  • Have worked on developer tools, IDEs, APIs, SDKs, cloud or developer infrastructure, DevOps, or another product built for software developers.
  • Have hands-on development experience or regularly work with code and developer tooling.
  • Know C#, .NET, Rider, ReSharper, Visual Studio, VS Code, or related developer ecosystems.
  • Have marketed AI-assisted development tools or are familiar with modern coding agents and AI developer workflows.
  • Have created technical content such as case studies, tutorials, product videos, demos, technical articles, or developer-focused campaigns.
  • Have experience working directly with developer communities or technical customers, including through webinars, interviews, or customer conversations.

What success looks like

Success means crafting clear, credible product narratives that help .NET developers understand the value of our tools, earning the trust of product and engineering teams, and continuously improving how we bring releases and campaigns to market.

Why join JetBrains?

  • Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
  • Flexible work location. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
  • Remote work. Spend up to 30 days per year working remotely from abroad.
  • Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.
  • Medical insurance allowance. Enjoy peace of mind for you and your family
  • Learning and development opportunities. Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.
  • Relocation support. We help make your move as smooth and stress-free as possible. 
  • Language classes. Pick up the local language or sharpen your English skills.
  • Fuel your day. Enjoy a hot meal or receive a lunch allowance on workdays.
  • Mental health support. To help you feel your best, we provide easy access to professional mental health services.
  • Sports benefit. Enjoy an on-site gym or sports club stipend.
  • Internal events. Join company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation.

If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.

  • Support the creation of assessments, microlearning units, and multimedia-based learning experiences.

Keeper is hiring a talented Technical Writer to join our Marketing team. This is a 100% remote position from select locations with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the Chicago, IL metro area.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and play an integral role in growing our online presence.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects more than 100,000 organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com.

About the Role

We are looking for a Technical Writer to create clear, accurate and engaging content about cybersecurity, identity security and emerging technology. This role will cover both Keeper’s products and broader industry topics, including security trends, best practices, compliance requirements, technical challenges and thought leadership. The ideal candidate is an excellent writer who enjoys learning complex products, asking thoughtful questions and making technical information accessible. Experience writing about cybersecurity, SaaS, identity security, privileged access management or related technologies is highly valued.

Responsibilities

  • Research and write technical content about cybersecurity, identity security, privileged access management, password security, non-human identities and related technologies
  • Create product one-pagers, datasheets, solution briefs, comparison guides, white papers, blog posts and website content
  • Develop educational content about industry trends, security risks, compliance requirements, best practices and emerging technologies
  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear, accurate and audience-appropriate messaging
  • Partner with Product Marketing and Product Management to understand product functionality, use cases, benefits and differentiators
  • Work with Engineering and subject matter experts to validate technical accuracy and ensure content reflects current product capabilities
  • Develop content for technical and business audiences, including security leaders, IT administrators, DevOps teams, developers, compliance professionals, partners and end users
  • Review and update existing content to ensure it remains accurate, current, consistent and aligned with Keeper’s messaging
  • Create content that clearly explains technical workflows, architecture, integrations, implementation considerations and customer benefits
  • Collaborate with SEO to develop search-informed content briefs and optimize content for relevant audiences and search intent
  • Maintain consistent terminology, tone, style and product naming across all technical content
  • Interview internal subject matter experts and turn technical discussions into polished, structured content
  • Manage multiple content projects simultaneously from research and outlining through review, revisions and publication
  • Stay current on cybersecurity trends, industry terminology, compliance requirements and emerging technologies

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in technical writing, content marketing, product marketing or a related field
  • Experience writing about technical products, software, cybersecurity, SaaS or enterprise technology
  • Ability to understand complex technical information and explain it clearly to different audiences
  • Strong research, interviewing, writing and editing skills
  • Experience creating structured content such as product documentation, technical briefs, datasheets, solution briefs or product pages
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, product managers, marketers and other subject matter experts
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to technical accuracy
  • Ability to multitask and be a self-starter
  • Ability to check all technical material for consistency and accuracy
  • Experience managing multiple projects and incorporating feedback from several stakeholders
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of assignments and meet deadlines
  • Ability to prioritize and execute tasks in a fast-paced environment

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience with cybersecurity, identity and access management, privileged access management, password management or compliance 
  • Familiarity with content management systems, preferably WordPress

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental & Vision (Inclusive of domestic partnerships)
  • Employer Paid Life Insurance & Employee/Spouse/Child Supplemental life
  • Voluntary Short/Long Term Disability Insurance
  • 401k (Roth/Traditional)

  • Above market annual bonuses

As a Technical SEO/GEO Developer, you will combine hands-on web development expertise with technical SEO knowledge to improve Keeper’s global websites across search visibility, crawlability, site performance and user experience.

You will work closely with Search Optimization, Product Marketing and Engineering to identify technical issues, implement fixes and ensure new and existing web experiences follow SEO best practices. You will also continuously audit Keeper’s global web properties to identify issues such as missing translations, incorrect canonical tags, broken links, indexing problems and other technical defects that may impact organic traffic, search performance or conversion.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct technical SEO audits focused on crawlability, indexation, site architecture, internal linking, redirects, canonicalization, JavaScript rendering and Core Web Vitals

  • Support SEO implementation across WordPress, including metadata, structured data, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, redirects, templates and page-level optimizations
  • Analyze how Keeper content appears in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity and other AI search experiences
  • Apply GEO principles to improve content structure, entity clarity, topical authority, internal linking and the likelihood of accurate brand and product representation in AI-generated answers
  • Implement SEO and GEO recommendations directly when possible, or provide clear tickets and technical requirements for Development
  • Use AI-assisted tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot or similar platforms to improve development, technical analysis, debugging, auditing and workflow efficiency
  • Use scripts, APIs or automation to streamline audits, reporting, internal linking analysis and recurring SEO workflows
  • Support international SEO across Keeper’s localized web experiences, including hreflang implementation, localization coverage and identification of missing or incorrect translations
  • Stay current on changes to search engine algorithms, AI search behavior, structured data and technical SEO best practices
  • Implement and validate canonical tags, redirects, metadata, structured data and other search-related website elements
  • Monitor crawlability and indexability and identify issues involving robots.txt, XML sitemaps, canonicalization and search engine directives
  • Identify and resolve broken links, duplicate content, redirect chains, orphaned pages and other site architecture issues
  • Develop improvements to internal linking and information architecture to strengthen discoverability and search performance
  • Validate SEO requirements during website launches, migrations, redesigns and new page development
  • Monitor production websites to identify technical regressions or unexpected changes that could affect search performance
  • Troubleshoot issues across HTML, CSS, JavaScript, rendering, APIs and content management systems
  • Work with analytics and SEO platforms to identify opportunities, measure results and prioritize technical improvements
  • Maintain clear documentation of technical SEO standards, development requirements and recurring audit processes

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional web development experience with hands-on technical SEO responsibilities
  • Strong proficiency with HTML, CSS and JavaScript
  • Experience developing, maintaining and troubleshooting production websites
  • Hands-on experience implementing technical SEO requirements, including canonical tags, redirects, structured data, metadata, XML sitemaps and robots.txt
  • Strong understanding of search engine crawling, rendering and indexing behavior
  • Experience identifying and resolving duplicate content, canonicalization, redirect and site architecture issues
  • Experience with international SEO concepts such as hreflang, localization and multilingual website architecture
  • Understanding of website performance, Core Web Vitals and frontend optimization
  • Familiarity with modern web frameworks, content management systems and Git-based development workflows
  • Experience using technical SEO and web analysis tools such as Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, Sitebulb or similar platforms
  • Familiarity with web analytics platforms and using data to evaluate website and search performance
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate issues across both web development and SEO layers
  • Ability to work effectively across Product Marketing, Search Optimization and Engineering teams
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify technical issues across large websites
  • Ability and willingness to use AI-assisted development and analysis tools effectively to improve coding, auditing, debugging and documentation
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Web Development, Information Systems, Marketing Technology or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting large, global or multilingual websites
  • Experience with React, Next.js or similar modern JavaScript frameworks
  • Familiarity with server-side rendering, static site generation and JavaScript SEO
  • Experience implementing schema.org structured data and validating rich-result eligibility
  • Experience with Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics or similar analytics platforms
  • Familiarity with CDN, caching and website delivery technologies
  • Experience automating technical SEO audits or validations using JavaScript, Python or similar scripting languages
  • Experience with A/B testing, conversion rate optimization or website experimentation
  • Experience working in SaaS, cybersecurity or another technology-focused environment

Description: TL;DR: Most companies treat documentation as a help centre. At Lovable it's part of the product. Millions of people learn to build software from our docs, and so do the AI agents working for them: the Lovable agent suggests pages, coding tools read them, and our assistants answer from them. You'll be our second technical writer, with product areas of your own from the start and a seat at every launch, and you'll help work out something nobody has fully worked out yet: what documentation should be when its readers are people and agents, and the product changes every day. Why Lovable? Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we're just getting started. We're building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. Lovable is one of TIME's 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe's fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software. What we're looking for You've spent 3+ years documenting software products, and you can show us pages that get a reader to the outcome without re-reading. You already write with AI: for research, drafting and checking, not just polish. You know what it gets wrong and you catch it. You test what you document. You'd rather try the feature and read the source than take someone's word for it, and when something's broken or confusing, you say so. You're at home in docs-as-code: Git, Markdown and pull requests. You ask engineers and PMs specific questions, and when documenting a feature shows it won't make sense to users, you raise it early, with reasons. Preferred: You've shipped docs weekly at a startup or scale-up, finding out what changed yourself. You've written for AI readers, or you're curious about it. You have UX writing or content design experience, or an interest in it. You can read code well enough to check how a feature actually behaves; writing code is not required. What you'll do Drive, don't wait. Features land every day, and bigger launches several times a month. You find out what's shipping before anyone tells you, and the docs are ready the day it ships. Own it end to end. Work a feature out from the code and the product, write the page, verify it in Lovable, ship it, and keep it true as the product moves. Care about the reader more than the feature. Our docs come with data: what people can't find, what the assistant couldn't answer, what support hears. You use it to decide what to write next. Make the product better, not just explain it. Documenting a feature means using it end to end. You'll find the confusing label or the broken step and get it fixed before launch. Write for three readers on one page. The non-technical builder, the developer, and the AI agent working on their behalf. Build something that outlasts the week. AI drafts a lot of our pages. The human work is judgement: what a feature needs, what the engineer didn't mention, and the checks that keep hundreds of pages correct. Where you'll start: Enterprise. Identity and access, governance, audit, data residency: the pages a security team reads before they sign. The developer surface. Take our API and MCP references from correct to complete. Your first launch. Own the docs for one in your first weeks, from working group to launch day. Your first automation. Pick one check we still do by hand and make it run on its own. About your application Please submit your application and your writing samples in English using the form below. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join. We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

Description:
About the job:

We’re looking for a technical writer / documentation engineer.

This job involves writing technical documentation for several of our products, and this includes instructions for end users using products with a web UI, integration instructions for developers installing our SDKs (in numerous languages), as well as API documentation for our REST APIs, and everything in between.

We use a docs-as-code approach, so you’ll spend most of your time writing Markdown or MDX, hosted in a Git repository, served as a Docusaurus website.

You’ll also dive into our CI operations, write internal documentation when needed, participate in discussions around product development, and advocate for our users. Similarly, you’ll sometimes build tools, and you’ll frequently run the projects that you’re documenting, for example you’ll occasionally integrate SDK code into a mock app just so that you can go through the steps that the end user (developer) would be going through.

You’ll frequently interview developers and product managers, as well as support and solutions engineers. You’ll have maybe one to three meetings a week, and most work is async. You’ll operate within the constraints of release deadlines, so good personal time management is important.

The technical writing team is currently a small one, so this job would involve taking ownership of a large portion of the documentation. This role is an expansion, not a backfill. You'll help shape our documentation roadmap and tackle our backlog, which we're hoping to make a little less impressive in size.

For an overview of how the products and existing docs look, see docs.microblink.com. 

 

What we’re looking for:

You are ideally either a technical writer in software, or a software engineer who has written documentation and liked it. Some other good backgrounds would be support engineer who has written documentation, solutions engineer who has written documentation… you get the picture. You have, in your professional life, written things down and made things clear for others, and you enjoyed this process. You also put in care to make the documentation good, not just a necessary evil. Having written a blog is a good but optional signal (the blog doesn’t need to be about techwriting or tech at all).

We’re looking for good technical skills, good writing skills, and high agency.

On the technical side of things, you should be able to code at least a little bit, and be able to read code in various languages. You’d primarily be reading Typescript, Kotlin, Swift, .NET and C++. You don’t need to have worked directly with these languages, but it helps if you’ve worked with programming languages in general before and you can find your way around a codebase.

Must-have skills, due to the nature of the job: 

  • Git: you must have at least a basic working knowledge, and here we also include Git-based workflows on GitHub.
  • Some command line, ideally a Linux or *nix one like Bash; you need to understand at least the basic operations, how to SSH into stuff, how to change directories, manage permissions, and so on.

On the writing side of things, we’re looking for someone who cares deeply about clarity and helping the reader. Your prime directive is to make things as easy to understand as possible, and to allow the users of our products to integrate them easily. This means switching between writing and editing, and cutting out as much noise as possible. Pull requests that are more red than green are good. We also expect you to extensively use AI for research and prototyping, without introducing slop into the docs.

On the high agency side of things: as this is a diverse, wide role, you should be able to look at your work comprehensively, holistically, and discern what makes sense, and what doesn’t. You should be able to advocate for doing what makes sense without having been told so. Frequently this will mean chasing someone who has the piece of information that you need, or doing investigative work in random git branches to find out when a change was introduced, or something else entirely.

A little bit about us:

Microblink is the Identity Intelligence OS that establishes Know Your Actor: control over people and agents, how risk is assessed, and how decisions are made across digital journeys. Built for an adversarial AI era, Microblink replaces static verification with continuous identity control. As the only solution spanning IDs, biometrics, and payment cards, Microblink delivers a real-time command center where signals, policies, and decisioning can be calibrated with granular precision. Companies use Microblink to adapt faster than fraud, optimize outcomes over time, and enforce trust at scale across onboarding, authentication, and every moment in between. In 2025, Microblink processed 2.9 billion identities across 195+ countries. Its proprietary Fraud Lab generates 100,000+ images monthly for training and testing models, achieving 100% deepfake detection in DHS-powered testing.

Here’s what you’ll gain if you join us:

  • Become part of a global B2B SaaS identity company where your contributions truly make an impact.
  • Enjoy flexible work arrangements - work remotely, hybrid, or from one of our offices, depending on your preference.
  • Unlimited PTO to support work-life balance.
  • Region-specific benefits tailored to your location.
  • Equity.

How can you join us?

If this role intrigues you, do not hesitate to hit the apply button and send us your resume. We are excited to meet talented people even if you don’t feel that you match 100% of the requirements.  So don’t let that discourage you, get in touch with us and we promise to get back to you.

This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, from hiring to the end of your business relationship with us. Accordingly, this job advertisement is equally applicable to all people and Microblink will make a hiring decision based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We prohibit discrimination of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws, as well as our internal policies and culture.

For detailed information on how we process personal data, please read our Privacy Policy https://microblink.com/privacy-policy/ or reach out to our Data Protection Officer at privacy@microblink.com.
