Description:
About us

Re-architecting Engineering for the Age of Intelligence

PhysicsX is the physics AI company for industrials. The company’s mission is to accelerate hardware innovation by overhauling what industrial engineering and manufacturing look like today. PhysicsX is building a new simulation software stack to deliver deep physics AI enablement across the entire engineering lifecycle. The company partners with leading organisations in aerospace & defence, automotive, semiconductors, materials, and energy & renewables, supporting them on some of their most critical and complex challenges. PhysicsX is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with offices in London, New York, and Singapore and an expanding presence in the Bay Area.

The Mission

We are looking for a Technical Writer to own our task based, in platform documentation and how to guides. This person will be responsible for the complete guide lifecycle: identifying and scoping documentation needs, then research, drafting, validation, publication, release updates, testing, and maintenance. These guides will form the authoritative technical foundation for our curriculum and training programmes. The Technical Writer will work closely with the curriculum lead, who will continue to own learning architecture, exercises, assessments, trainer materials, and broader adoption initiatives.

Many customers do not have in house specialist knowledge in all areas of our platform capabilities, so the documentation must enable technically literate users to complete appropriate machine learning and simulation workflows independently. Guides should evolve with every platform release, and should be scoped starting at the engineering level and carried through to clear, customer facing guides. Early priorities include plugging existing gaps, building foundational machine learning explainer content for technical and non technical readers, and supporting new feature rollouts.

This role owns procedural, task based documentation. Curriculum, training, and business development consumes and builds on that documentation rather than recreating or independently maintaining the same content.

Core Responsibilities

  • Scope how to guides in detail per topic, as directed by Product User Enablement GTM leadership, leveraging existing Product and Delivery materials to build repeatable, distributable guides, and build in new product features as they ship
  • Create and publish new how to guides, coordinating with subject matter experts and using pre built skills and writing rules to move quickly
  • Maintain all existing guides on a regular schedule
  • Partner with the curriculum lead to ensure published guides provide a reliable technical foundation for training, while curriculum design, learning pathways, exercises, and trainer materials remain owned by the curriculum lead
  • Gain approval from GTM leadership and relevant subject matter experts on every user guide before it is published

Success Measures

  • Every priority workflow is supported by an accurate, tested how-to guide
  • Guides are maintained alongside each platform release
  • Published guides can be referenced by training curriculum without recreating procedural content
  • Documentation gaps and stale content are tracked through a visible backlog
  • Product users can complete common workflows independently

Ownership and Collaboration

This role owns procedural, task based documentation as the single source of truth for product guidance. Curriculum, training, and enablement content build on these guides rather than recreating them.

  • Curriculum lead: Owns learning architecture, exercises, assessments, and trainer materials, and partners with this role to keep training content grounded in the published guides.
  • Subject matter experts: Help develop and review new and updated guides, particularly within Delivery. Every guide requires their sign off alongside GTM leadership before publication.
  • Product and Engineering: Provide the core engineering and product concepts needed to create clear, customer facing guidance and incorporate new features as they ship.
  • GTM leadership: Prioritises which user guide topics are needed.

Essential Experience

  • Demonstrable experience in technical writing, developer relations or documentation engineering
  • Curriculum, training or technical documentation experience
  • Strong proficiency with Markdown, and ideally MkDocs or a similar tool
  • Experience working in MD or AsciiDoc files
  • Experience with version control via GitHub
  • Comfortable with docs as code workflows and CI/CD integration
  • Familiarity with the Diataxis documentation framework (tutorials, how to guides, reference, explanation)
  • Comfortable using company docs guidelines and agentic writing skills
  • Ability to write clear, concise prose that respects readers' time

How You Work

  • You can assess documentation from the target reader’s perspective and ensure technically literate non-specialists can understand and complete the documented workflows independently.
  • You can verify technical accuracy independently, without relying on engineers to write the content for you
  • You are a systems thinker who builds coherent information architectures rather than documenting features in isolation
  • You are comfortable coordinating across a wide set of subject matter experts, particularly within user-enabling Delivery

Desirable Experience

  • MkDocs, or a similar tool such as Mintlify or Zensical, plus Markdown and Sphinx
  • A physical industry background is preferred, for example simulation, machine learning, design or manufacturing
  • Demonstrated experience documenting APIs, SDKs or developer tooling is a plus given the platform's technical depth
  • Background in simulation or engineering workflows
  • Familiarity with scientific computing libraries such as NumPy and SciPy
  • Understanding of how AI agents consume documentation, for example structured descriptions and tool schemas
  • Prior freelance experience in this space, including candidates who could convert to a permanent role and start with no notice period

We are seeking an experienced Technical Content Engineer to join our Customer and Product Education team. In this role, you will be the architect of our technical narrative and the systems behind it, ensuring our customers and the AI agents that increasingly serve them have the right information at the exact moment it's needed. You'll go beyond writing "how-to" articles; you will design and organize a logic-driven knowledge base that serves two audiences, our customers and AI agents (including the Documentation Agent in the Pigment platform), and you'll own the quality of content for both. Working at the intersection of Product and Customer Experience, you'll partner with subject matter experts to translate high-level product updates, including Pigment's native AI capabilities that allow users to build models simply by speaking their intent, into clear, concise, and discoverable content that drives self-service and empowers our users to master the platform independently. You'll also help shape how documentation is created and maintained, building AI-assisted, docs-as-code workflows that connect our knowledge base, our product specs, and our platform. Architect Information: Design intuitive content layouts and visual aids within our knowledge base, making strategic decisions on content length and structure to maximize user comprehension and self-service. Structure content so it can be reliably chunked, retrieved, and cited by AI agents, not only read by people. Innovate with AI: Stay ahead of the curve by exploring and implementing AI-driven workflows to streamline content creation, from drafting and quality checks to content audits, while keeping editorial judgment at the center. Train and Tune the Documentation Agent: Partner with Product and Engineering to improve the Documentation Agent in the Pigment platform. Curate source content, write and refine agent instructions and evaluation prompts, review agent answers for accuracy, and feed gaps back into the knowledge base. Run Docs as Code: Manage content through Git-based workflows (Markdown, pull requests, and automated checks for links, structure, and style) so documentation ships in step with product releases. Automate and Scale Content Operations: Build lightweight automation and AI-assisted workflows that reduce repetitive work, and make it easier for Product, Engineering, and Professional Services colleagues to contribute accurate documentation. Master the Product: Proactively explore new product functionalities and build clear, relevant use-case examples that help customers bridge the gap between feature and value. Collaborate and Influence: Build trust and rapport with cross-functional teams including Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Professional Services to navigate blockers, gather requirements, and ensure documentation is ready at the moment of release. Drive Strategy and Impact: Use data-driven insights, including both traditional knowledge base analytics and measures of how well content performs for agents (such as answer accuracy and retrieval quality), to recommend improvements to our knowledge base. Thrive in Agility: Effectively prioritize and organize your tasks to meet deadlines in our fast-paced environment, maintaining focus on project goals even when demands or product priorities shift. Be a Mentor: Act as a main contributor to our team's documentation standards, including AI and docs-as-code practices, and provide guidance to peers to ensure high-quality output across the board. Who you are: 3-5 years of experience in technical writing, content strategy, or documentation engineering, preferably within the SaaS, EPM, or FinTech space. Strong command of authoring, hosting, and collaboration tools, such as Document360, Jira / Confluence, Git / GitHub, and Markdown (VS Code). Hands-on experience with docs-as-code workflows (Git, pull requests, Markdown, and CI-based checks). Practical experience using LLMs in a writing workflow, including prompting, critically reviewing output, and building repeatable workflows. An understanding of what makes content machine-readable as well as human-readable (consistent structure, self-contained sections, clear metadata). Strong editorial judgment, including the ability to verify AI-generated content for accuracy and to produce content that automation can't get to the right standard on its own. Proven ability to independently learn complex product functionality and translate it into clear, concise instructions for both technical and non-technical audiences. Excellent verbal and written communication skills and a can-do attitude when faced with complex technical puzzles. Experience using data and insights to inform content decisions and measure the effectiveness of documentation. Highly collaborative mindset with the ability to work across various time zones and departments to achieve a common goal. Professional fluency in English is required; proficiency in French is a significant advantage, as many of our Product colleagues are French speakers. Nice to Have: Scripting ability (Python or JavaScript) for automation. Familiarity with RAG concepts, llms.txt, or MCP. Experience evaluating or improving the output of an AI assistant or agent. Description:
Technical Writer 

Location: Hyderabad, India

OUR MISSION

At Redwood Software, we unleash human potential. We empower our customers with lights-out automation for their mission-critical business processes.

ABOUT US

Redwood Software is the leader in full-stack automation for mission-critical business processes. With the first SaaS-based composable automation platform specifically built for ERP, we believe in automation's transformative power. Our unparalleled solutions empower organizations to orchestrate, manage, and monitor their workflows across any application, service, or server — in the cloud or on-premise — with confidence and control.

CORE VALUES

One Team. One Redwood Make Your Own Weather Obsess over Customer Success Work the Problem Be Curious Own the Outcome Respect Each Other

YOUR IMPACT

As a Technical Writer at Redwood, you'll create and maintain documentation for our Tidal product line, working closely with product, engineering, and UX/design to keep customer-facing documentation and in-product content accurate and consistent. 

You bring solid technical writing skills and sound judgment on ambiguous product or design questions. You're curious about applying AI tools to your own workflow, and comfortable partnering with designers and senior writers on content strategy. You'll follow and contribute to documentation and content design standards set by the team, and make structural or strategic content calls as they arise, looping in your lead on cross-team tradeoffs.

Documentation Development

  • Write and maintain user guides, implementation documentation, developer content, and release notes for Tidal and Finance Automation, keeping pace with each release cycle. 
  • Produce API documentation (e.g., using Swagger/OpenAPI) for developer-facing endpoints as needed. 
  • Translate technical concepts — such as job scheduling and workload orchestration in Tidal, or financial close and reconciliation processes in Finance Automation — into content suited to administrators, developers, and business users. 
  • Keep existing documentation current as products change, verifying accuracy directly with engineering and product owners.

Content Design Collaboration

  • Partner with UX/design on in-product content, UI text, tooltips, error messages, onboarding copy.
  • Apply established content design principles (structure, findability, consistency) to your own documentation work. 
  • Identify and resolve content inconsistencies or gaps across docs and in-product text, looping in the team when a fix touches shared standards.

AI-Assisted Documentation 

  • Use approved AI tools to assist with drafting, editing, and structuring documentation, always reviewing AI-assisted output for accuracy before publishing. 
  • Identify and pilot opportunities to apply AI to documentation workflows, bringing outcomes back to the team.

Documentation Publishing & Operations

  • Publish and maintain documentation using the team's Git-based, docs-as-code workflow (Markdown, version control). 
  • Maintain metadata, organization, and versioning of published docs according to team standards. 
  • Update published content in response to product changes, customer feedback, and post-release review.

Team Collaboration

  • Use Jira and Confluence within established team workflows. 
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies and deliver content aligned to sprint/release cycles. 
  • Communicate progress, blockers, and scope changes proactively so your lead can adjust priorities and timelines. 
  • Collaborate with SMEs and product stakeholders to verify technical accuracy.


YOUR EXPERIENCE

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Technical Communication, English, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience. 
  • 3-5 years of technical writing experience for software products, ideally in B2B SaaS. 
  • Experience producing user guides, API documentation, and release notes in a fast-release (Agile/sprint-based) environment. 
  • Experience using Jira and Confluence for project tracking and collaboration. 
  • Experience with Git-based, docs-as-code workflows and lightweight markup (e.g., Markdown). 
  • Experience applying AI tools to documentation work, whether from prior job experience or self-directed exploration.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, attention to detail, ability to manage multiple priorities.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with API documentation tools (e.g., Swagger/OpenAPI). 
  • Experience partnering with UX/design teams on in-product content or microcopy. 
  • Experience with workload automation, enterprise software, or cloud-based platforms.

Technical Product Managers combine deep technical knowledge and experience with product leadership capabilities which are needed to enable Riot Games to deliver key products and experiences to make it better to be a player. As a Principal Technical Product Manager for VALORANT Foundations, reporting to the Director of Technical Product Management for VALORANT, you’ll identify and lead the highest-impact opportunities across the platforms that make the game predictable to build, release and operate worldwide. Foundations serves VALORANT’s engineers, artists and designers through build and release pipelines, developer tools and workflows, engine capabilities and core backend services. Working with engineering leads, game teams and central technology partners, you’ll bring independent product judgment to ambiguous problems, build support for a clear direction, and lead delivery across teams without direct authority. Your success will be measured in faster development workflows, more predictable releases, and platforms that let VALORANT grow sustainably.

  • Define and align product strategy for critical, cross-cutting platform areas, prioritizing outcomes that create measurable value for developers and players
  • Bring strategic structure and clarity to Foundations' hardest, most ambiguous initiatives so they're set up for long-term success

  • Champion AI-augmented ways of working: bring agentic tooling into the PM craft to compress cycle time and model what modern product management looks like for Foundations

  • 8+ years of relevant experience in Technical Product Management or a related engineering/technical field
  • Familiarity with the game development lifecycle: engines, art/build toolchains, live-ops workflows
  • Proven ability to operate at a Principal level, navigating organizational complexity to drive outcomes without direct authority
  • Strong technical background (CS degree or equivalent experience) sufficient to credibly debate tradeoffs with engineering leads
  • Experience translating open-ended or ambiguous technical capabilities into concrete product roadmaps with defined milestones and success metrics
  • Track record owning platform, developer-tools, or systems products with internal customers
  • Experience integrating agentic AI tooling into the product-management craft, using agents to shorten the loop from insight to execution

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience with developer experience / platform-as-a-product domains, including internal platforms, SDKs, or CI/CD tooling
  • Experience operating across the studio/central-tech boundary, or in a shared-infrastructure org serving multiple teams
  • Hands-on familiarity with Unreal Engine and the Unreal Editor, VALORANT's engine and the primary environment its developers work in

Description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Have you built something with AI that changed how your team works? Maybe it's an agentic workflow that runs a process from start to finish, or an automation that fixed an operational problem nobody else could solve. We're looking for a senior builder who already works this way and is ready to do it at scale. You'll own projects in our AI-native knowledge framework. You'll work with subject matter experts and peers to create customer documentation and to design the systems that produce it. Experience in technical writing or content development helps, but your track record of building with AI matters most.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best. 

Learn more about what we value at Samsara.

In this role, you will:

  • Design and build AI-powered workflows that change how we create, review, and maintain knowledge content. Examples include agentic pipelines that draft articles from product release information, or automations that flag outdated content.
  • Find operational problems across the knowledge program and solve them with AI, from intake and routing to quality checks and SME review.
  • Own projects on the content operations roadmap from scoping through delivery, including timelines, dependencies, and stakeholder updates.
  • Set and improve the processes and standards the team uses to develop knowledge, and make sure they work well with our AI tools.
  • Track KPIs on how well our knowledge content performs, share what you learn, and use the data to decide what to build or fix next.
  • Work with subject matter experts and peers to create and maintain accurate customer documentation.

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • 6+ years of professional experience in operations, program management, knowledge management, technical writing, content development, learning and development, or a related field
  • Hands-on experience building AI solutions to operational problems, such as agentic workflows, multi-step automations, or AI tools connected to other systems. You can walk us through what you built, why you built it, and what changed as a result
  • Experience owning projects from start to finish, including scoping, timelines, dependencies, and coordination across teams
  • Experience creating or maintaining technical content, such as documentation, training materials, or knowledge base articles
  • A track record of spotting problems and solving them without detailed direction
  • Clear communication with cross-functional partners and stakeholders at every level

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience connecting AI tools to other systems through APIs, automation platforms, or MCP servers
  • Experience structuring content so AI systems can retrieve and use it accurately
  • Proficiency in Jira and experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
  • Experience with Confluence and Zendesk, or similar knowledge and support platforms
  • Experience querying data and building dashboards, ideally in Databricks or with SQL
  • A background in knowledge management or technical writing

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily. 

MONOPOLY GO! is a global phenomenon and the biggest mobile game launch in history, captivating millions of players worldwide.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Execute on content plans for features, events, and seasonal experiences
  • Create design documents and pitches
  • Help assess content needs for features 
  • Design theming and narrative for exciting content such sticker sets, minigames, character designs and more
  • Help maintain the consistency and integrity of the Monopoly brand, as well as any brands of our licensed IP partners
  • Apply knowledge of player empathy and knowledge of the game and brand to create content aimed to deliver delight, wonder, and meaningful player moments
  • Clearly communicate creative concepts, decisions, opportunities, and solutions through reviews, presentations, and supporting documentation
  • Participate actively and constructively in creative reviews and planning
  • Work with production to balance quality, timelines, dependencies, and production requirements
  • Develop a strong understanding of our team’s creative and design goals in order to contribute ideas and solutions that advance those goals
  • Build productive working relationships with partners across disciplines, proactively seeking context and incorporating different perspectives
  • Stay aware of changes and priorities across the broader team and adapt your work appropriately as needs evolve
  • Demonstrate Scopely’s tenets in day-to-day work, treating colleagues with fairness, respect, empathy, and compassion.

What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of relevant professional experience in content design, game design, narrative design, game writing, creative development, or a related discipline.
  • Creative problem solving skills.
  • Resourceful and strategic thinking.
  • A portfolio or body of work demonstrating creative or narrative content and strong craft fundamentals.
  • Experience with short-form writing skills, including either/or copywriting, UX Writing
  • Experience contributing to scoped creative work from concept through implementation and delivery.
  • Strong understanding of how narrative, creative content, and design choices contribute to the overall player experience.
  • Ability to work within limitations such as technical constraints, brand restrictions or game mechanics.
  • Strong player empathy, appeal, and an ability to create content with a clear understanding of the intended audience, brand, and player experience.
  • Ability to communicate complex creative ideas and rationale clearly creative stakeholders and external partners.
  • Ability to leverage multiple IPs into a satisfying, cohesive experience for players.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to build productive relationships across disciplines.
  • Ability to receive, evaluate, and act on feedback while also providing thoughtful and constructive feedback to peers.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, including consistent documentation, file management, and adherence to established production conventions.
  • Experience using tools such as JIRA, Google Suite, Slack, Miro, Zoom, Airtable, Localization databases
  • Strong interest in mobile games.
  • Strong knowledge of pop culture/cultural zeitgeist.

 

Bonus Points

 

  • Previous experience as a creative in the entertainment industry, either in film, animation, storyboarding, live theater, theme park design, or escape room design
  • Previous experience in the visual arts

 

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

The name says it all. AI's real promise isn't efficiency or cost savings. It's giving customers back something they lost—the feeling of being truly understood and cared for. Not satisfied. Delighted

The Product

Delight.ai is the AI concierge for customer experience. Most AI agents forget you the moment the conversation ends. Ours doesn't. Delight.ai builds memory over time, learns preferences, and connects context across every channel without losing the thread. We're building AI that makes customers feel understood, seen, and remembered.

The Role

The Technical Writing team at Sendbird empowers developers to build successful businesses on our platform by delivering high-quality content — from documentation and user guides to tutorials, UI text, and beyond. As a Technical/UX Writer, you'll be at the center of the developer experience, transforming complex technical concepts into content that is clear, concise, and actionable.

You might be this person if

  • You quickly spot friction in the user experience — whether it's a confusing UI label, unclear documentation, or a workflow that loses developers halfway through — and you can articulate exactly what's wrong and why.
  • You're a critical thinker who questions the obvious and finds a better path when the conventional one doesn't work.
  • You're genuinely curious about AI — not just as a trend, but as a tool you actively use to work faster and smarter. Sendbird encourages all members to tap into the most advanced tools available.
  • You thrive in cross-functional work. You'll collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and UX designers to create content that meets real customer needs.

  • You're not afraid to ask questions. When you need context, resources, or a second opinion, you seek them out — proactively and without hesitation.

  • Create content: Develop and maintain high-quality documentation, user guides, and UI text strings for Sendbird's products, ensuring clarity and accuracy.
  • Write UX copy: Craft button labels, error messages, onboarding flows, and tooltips that guide users with minimal friction.
  • Improve content: Build an effective feedback loop and integrate customer insights into our content.
  • Work with AI: Use AI tools actively in your writing workflow — to draft, restructure, automate, and iterate — while applying your own judgment to every output.
  • Stay current: Research competitor products, B2B trends, and developer communities to keep our content competitive and relevant.

You need to have

  • AI proficiency: You've used AI tools in real writing or content work. You know how to direct them with purpose, and you treat their output as a first draft.

Description:
Talon.One, an Adyen company, is the most powerful incentives engine that unifies loyalty, personalized promotions and offer management into a single platform.
Built for enterprise scale and security, Talon.One helps businesses design and deliver incentives that drive real customer behavior.

Today, over 300 of the world’s most-loved brands including Sephora, Gymshark and Costa Coffee work with Talon.One to turn their incentives into a reliable growth engine.

ABOUT THE TEAM:

The Developer Experience (DevX) team supports customers integrating and using our platform. The team is responsible for the product docs, developer docs, in-product UX copy, and the technical infrastructure behind the docs platform. Our primary audience spans two groups: business users operating the product and backend engineers integrating our APIs.

Your primary mission is to contribute to and help maintain our end-user and developer documentation, API references, and UX copy. You will write new content to keep pace with the product's evolution and optimize existing content to make it more readable and maintainable. You will also have the opportunity to shape how we manage technical documentation across the company.

We’re seeking a professional based in Berlin.

ONCE YOU ARE HERE YOU WILL:

  • Treat the docs as a product: Own the architecture of your sections of the docs, maintain the content roadmap, prioritize backlog requests from cross-functional teams, and track metrics/feedback to continuously improve the user experience.
  • Deliver end-user and API documentation: Write, edit, and maintain clear API references, integration guides, and end-user documentation using OpenAPI Specifications, Markdown, and static site tools.
  • Craft in-product UX copy: Collaborate closely with Product Designers and Product Managers to write intuitive, clear microcopy for our product’s UI.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work with engineers, product managers, and product designers to translate complex software architecture into accessible, actionable guidance.

WHAT WE NEED YOU TO BRING TO THE TABLE:

  • Exceptional English communication skills to deliver precise documentation and collaborate effectively during agile ceremonies and cross-functional workshops
  • 2+ years of experience in technical writing, developer relations, or UX copy
  • Technical literacy, including a solid grasp of APIs (REST/OpenAPI) or SDKs
  • Product-oriented mindset to manage your own documentation backlog, and analyze key performance metrics based on developer feedback
  • Expertise in crafting concise in-product microcopy that optimizes user workflows and reduces friction
  • In-depth understanding of modern documentation strategies, such as docs-as-code, minimalism, and topic-oriented, user-centric writing
  • Experience with our tool stack or equivalent, including Git, GitHub, Visual Studio Code, Docusaurus, Scalar, and Figma
WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU:
  • 120+ team of engineers, product managers and product designers in Berlin
  • Leaders with 8+ years of experience building our promotions engine
  • €1,000 annual learning budget and free German language courses to boost your skills
  • 30 days of annual leave, plus extra paid days for your birthday and moving day
  • Home office setup budget, a monthly home office allowance
  • Freedom to work from abroad for up to 90 days worldwide!
  • Mental health support with nilo.health and a discounted Urban Sports Club membership
  • 20% company subsidy on your pension contributions
  • Subsidised BVG public transport ticket and a dog-friendly Berlin office where your furry friend is welcome
  • Lease your ideal bike through BusinessBike

WHY YOU SHOULD WORK FOR US:

  • The right attitude: modern methods and a diverse, creative workspace with an open and international culture
  • Everyone for the product: Together we create a flexible, highly scalable product with state-of-the-art technologies. We can only succeed if everyone works as a team
  • Healthy Growth: Growing our company means growing everyone in the team. We love to share knowledge and learn
  • A great environment: Flexible and family-friendly environment, bright and easily accessible offices, modern software and hardware
  • High flexibility degree: Prefer to work early or late at night? Do you have to pick up your children from kindergarten? Do you prefer working abroad? We believe in results and motivated employees

AI is rapidly transforming the world. As generative AI reshapes industries, teams need powerful ways to monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize their AI systems. That’s where we come in. Arize AI is the leading AI & Agent Engineering observability and evaluation platform, empowering AI engineers to ship high-performing, reliable agents and applications. Arize serves a rapidly growing customer base of 150+ leading enterprises and Fortune 500 companies. Customers like Booking.com, Uber, Siemens, and PepsiCo leverage Arize to deliver AI that works.

About Arize AI

Arize AI is an AI observability and evaluation platform helping teams build, evaluate, and improve AI applications and agents. From development through production, Arize gives AI engineering teams the tools to understand how their systems perform, identify failures, and continuously improve their applications.

Our ecosystem includes Arize AX, our managed platform for AI observability and evaluations, and Phoenix, our open-source platform built for AI engineers.

About the Role

We're looking for a Director of Content & Editorial to lead how Arize educates, engages, and builds trust with the AI engineering community.

The AI engineering market is moving quickly. Developers are building increasingly sophisticated agents, enterprises are deploying AI into production, and teams are looking for practical guidance on how to evaluate, observe, and improve these systems.

Arize is at the center of these conversations. We have deep technical expertise, strong engineering perspectives, and a growing ecosystem of builders using our products.

Your job is to turn that expertise into content that people genuinely want to read, watch, share, and learn from.

This is a hands-on editorial leadership role. We're not looking for someone who only manages a content calendar or delegates writing. We need an exceptional writer and editor who can develop a content strategy, work directly with technical subject matter experts, produce outstanding content, and build a scalable editorial program.

You'll own Arize's editorial direction across technical education, industry thought leadership, product storytelling, executive perspectives, and customer content.

What You'll Do

Own content and editorial strategy

  • Develop and execute a content strategy that builds Arize's authority in AI observability, agent evaluations, and the broader AI engineering ecosystem.
  • Establish clear editorial priorities for developers, AI engineering teams, AI product leaders, and enterprise technology buyers.
  • Build and manage an editorial calendar across technical blogs, educational guides, thought leadership, customer stories, newsletters, and other content formats.
  • Identify emerging industry trends and develop distinctive editorial perspectives that position Arize as a trusted voice.
  • Maintain high standards for technical accuracy, clarity, originality, and editorial quality.

Create technically credible content

  • Personally write, edit, and produce high-quality technical and strategic content.
  • Partner directly with engineers, researchers, PMMs, DevRel, and executives to develop content grounded in practical experience.
  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear, useful material without oversimplifying them.
  • Develop technical tutorials, explainers, deep dives, and educational resources that help developers solve real problems.
  • Build original content around product innovation, engineering insights, and emerging approaches to agent evaluation and observability.

Build thought leadership and industry authority

  • Work closely with Arize's founders and technical leaders to develop original perspectives on the future of AI engineering.
  • Identify opportunities for industry commentary, research, opinion pieces, and technical thought leadership.
  • Partner with Marketing and DevRel to amplify important ideas through publications, social channels, podcasts, speaking opportunities, and community engagement.
  • Develop content that earns attention and credibility rather than relying on promotional messaging.

Partner on SEO, AEO, and content distribution

  • Collaborate with Growth and SEO/AEO to identify high-value topics, content gaps, and opportunities to improve search and AI-answer visibility.
  • Own the editorial quality and development of content designed to support organic discovery.
  • Refresh and improve existing content to maintain relevance, accuracy, and authority.
  • Build distribution strategies that extend the reach of high-value content across web, email, social, and partner channels.
  • Use performance data and audience feedback to inform editorial decisions.

Build a scalable content operation

  • Manage freelance writers, editors, and other external content resources.
  • Develop clear editorial workflows that enable consistent, high-quality publishing.
  • Establish effective processes for working with technical subject matter experts.
  • Prioritize content based on audience value, strategic relevance, and business impact.
  • Partner across the marketing organization to support campaigns, launches, events, and major company initiatives.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years of experience in content, editorial, technical writing, or content marketing, including ownership of editorial strategy.
  • Exceptional writing and editing skills, with a portfolio demonstrating technical depth and clear thinking.
  • Experience producing content for developers, engineers, or highly technical B2B audiences.
  • Strong understanding of AI development, developer tooling, cloud infrastructure, or related technical markets.
  • Proven ability to interview technical experts and turn complex ideas into authoritative content.
  • Experience building editorial programs across multiple formats and distribution channels.
  • Understanding of SEO and how editorial content contributes to organic discoverability.
  • Experience managing freelancers, agencies, or small editorial teams.
  • Strong editorial judgment and the ability to balance technical credibility, audience interests, and business priorities.
  • Comfortable operating as both a strategic leader and an individual contributor.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on familiarity with LLM applications, AI agents, agent evaluations, and observability.
  • Experience at an AI infrastructure or developer tools company.
  • Experience writing technical tutorials or documentation-adjacent educational content.
  • Experience developing executive thought leadership and original research.
  • Familiarity with open-source communities and developer-led adoption.
  • Understanding of AEO and how content earns visibility in AI-generated answers.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 6–12 months, you'll have:

  • Established a distinctive, technically credible editorial voice for Arize.
  • Built a consistent publishing program with clear strategic priorities.
  • Produced technical content that engineers trust and return to.
  • Increased the reach and engagement of Arize's thought leadership and educational content.
  • Worked with Growth to increase organic content contribution to qualified traffic and acquisition.
  • Built a reliable network of technical contributors and freelance resources.

Actual compensation is determined based upon a variety of job related factors that may include: transferable work experience, skill sets, and qualifications. Total compensation also includes a comprehensive benefit package, including: medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, unlimited paid time off, generous parental leave plan, and others for mental and wellness support.

More About Arize

Arize’s mission is to make the world’s AI work—and work for people.
Our founders came together through a shared frustration: while investments in AI are growing rapidly across every industry, organizations face a critical challenge—understanding whether AI is performing and how to improve it at scale.

About the role: 

Working in true collaboration with our client Unilever, OLIVER U-Studio's goal is to be the leading agency partner for the development of stunning, effective, needs-based content and digital/social media campaigns.

We work cross-category, spanning Foods, Refreshment, Home Care and Beauty/Personal Care — some of the best-loved brands in the market, alongside a premium portfolio and exciting new brand launches. These brands sit at the forefront of contemporary thinking, using deep insight to drive digital strategy and content advertising, and they're committed to sustainability and brand purpose; which means every brief, regardless of scale, calls for real creative thinking.

 

What you will be doing: 

As a Social Content Creator (Brand Journalist), you're one of the engines behind that output. This role is copywriting at its base, but it goes further: you're not only writing content, you're creating it. That includes ideating, scripting and helping produce the high-volume, content-led ads and social assets our Unilever brands need to stay always-on.

We're looking for a true social native: fast, witty, flexible, and able to bring real range of variety, abundance and richness to how you think about, plan and execute content. And because of OLIVER's in-house agency model, you'll also need to be confident interacting directly with clients.

  • Ideating and writing social-first content across formats (short-form video scripts, captions, carousels, stories and trend-jack contents) for Facebook, TikTok, Instagram and beyond.
  • Producing high volumes of content-led ads and always-on social content for multiple Unilever brands, often in parallel.
  • Adapting each brand's tone of voice for social-native, platform-specific execution (eg. By recognizing that what works on TikTok isn't what works on Facebook)
  • Spotting and reacting to trends, memes and cultural moments quickly, finding brand-relevant angles before they go stale.
  • Writing with strong channel-understanding: Knowing how each platform's algorithm, format and audience behavior shape what actually gets seen and engaged with.
  • Partnering with other U-Studio creatives (designers, video editors, art directors, etc.) to plan and execute collaborative projects (visual direction, content production, editing and shooting, etc.)
  • Supporting content project planning: Building and maintaining content calendars, and prioritizing output against briefs and deadlines.
  • Conducting light social research to ground content in real consumer insight and category trends, particularly in beauty/personal care.
  • Interacting directly with clients where needed, pitching and defending content ideas.

 

What you need to be great in this role: 

  • Strong content-writing and storytelling skills, with a portfolio that shows range across formats and tones.
  • Genuine social-media fluency. You live on these platforms and understand what makes content perform, not just what looks good.
  • Speed and flexibility; Comfortable producing high volumes of content without sacrificing quality or wit.
  • A confident thinker, able to generate ideas solo or in a team setting
  • Comfortable writing across long-form (digital/web) and short-form (social) formats depending on the brief.
  • Solid channel-understanding, fluent in how different platforms work, so content is built for where it will actually live, not just repurposed onto it.
  • Skilled at content structuring and framework building, able to turn a one-off idea into a reusable structure, not just produce single, disconnected posts.
  • Flexible and familiar with multiple content-creation methods: angle/pillar-based single posts, modular/templated series, and trend-capturing or pop-up content.
  • Strong collaboration skills & Highly organized, able to manage multiple briefs and projects at once without losing quality.
  • Passion for and curiosity about AI and new content tools; understanding of AI tools is a plus, but the ability to quickly learn and adopt them is critical.
  • At least 2 years of experience working with social agency
  • Passion for and inquisitive about AI and new technologies. 
  • Understanding and knowledge of AI tools is beneficial, but ability to learn and digest benefits and features of AI tools is critical. 

Nice to have:

  • Experience working on FMCG, beauty or personal care brands
  • Experience with short-form video scripting, filming or light editing
  • Fluency in both Vietnamese and English, written and spoken

Description:
Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, where you gain a tremendous amount of responsibility? Do you want to be part of an exceptional entrepreneurial team with young, motivated and extremely driven people? And are you curious or passionate about people? If so, you might be our next Content Writer.

About us

SetSales is Northern Europe’s leading sales community and aims to connect and develop commercially-minded executives, decision makers in sales, and aspiring entrepreneurs. We are connecting more than 4,000 professionals from more than 15 countries every year.

SetSales is part of United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. 

What we offer you

As our Content Writer you get the unique opportunity to take ownership of our content. You’ll be working in-person in your HQ in London where you will constantly be pushed out of your comfort zone. To ensure a never ending growth curve, we provide you with:

  • Opportunity of having a real impact - You’ll be getting operational experience in a start-up where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matter to the business.
  • Inspiration and guidance - A chance to work closely with our high performing team as well as with the CEO and founder of our company.
  • Unlimited growth potential in our company - we strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally.
  • Travel opportunity: You would be joining our conferences overseas.
  • Invaluable transferable skills - boost your interpersonal, research, organisation, outreach and project management skills through experience and training.

Your Responsibilities

Responsibilities in this job will vary however, they will be mostly centred around:

  • Email marketing: Manage copywriting, graphics, strategy and optimisation for our newsletter, product updates and exclusive promotions.
  • Social media growth management: Manage and grow our LinkedIn - our largest channel to interact with our audience - and frequently test new content formats. We would also like you to help us leverage our content on YouTube and launch our Twitter.
  • Graphic design: You will be responsible for our visual identity across all of our marketing channels. We will make sure you’re equipped to do this in the best way possible.
  • Website: Design, SEO activities, UX optimisation. Work with us on improving and launching new formats that reflect our brand identity.
  • Analytics: To continuously measure and improve our performance metrics across channels. You will be working towards challenging targets and KPIs.
  • Paid advertising and PPC campaign management.
  • Synergy: To collaborate with the other departments to identify content worth sharing with our audience, and also to inform them of our brands’ progress.

What we expect from you

Please note that this job does not require any specific previous work experience as training is provided and we are looking to incorporate candidates across different levels of experience. However, we do require you to have a UK work permit. We also expect candidates to have obtained a bachelors or masters degree, or to be working towards obtaining university qualification.

Furthermore, we are looking for candidates who:

  • Have a relentless drive and desire to be the very best at what they do;
  • Possess and unparalleled work ethic with a high sense of urgency;
  • Take ownership of everything they do, are proactive and follow through on commitments;
  • Are curious about people and love to speak, build and nurture relations;
  • Are an excellent communicator (especially) verbally and in writing;
  • Are well-organised and display the ability to structure and prioritise their work.

Startdate

Flexible

The role is onsite, Monday to Friday, based in our offices at Buckingham Gate. It is essential we work at a fast pace and collaborate in person to create market-leading, unmatched events throughout the calendar year. It will be great to have you as part of our team.

Bliv en del af T&P reklamebureau

Kan du skrive tekster, der virker? Har du styr på sociale medier, digitale platforme og forskellige målgrupper? Og kan du omsætte en kreativ idé til indhold, der engagerer? Så er du måske vores nye Content Writer.

Hos T&P bliver du en central del af vores kreative team. Du producerer indhold på tværs af kanaler på dansk og arbejder tæt sammen med Account Managers, Art Directors og kreative kolleger om at udvikle og eksekvere content, der skaber resultater.
Fra sociale medier og websites til CRM, kampagner og annoncer. Du følger opgaverne hele vejen fra første udkast til færdigt materiale.

Du kommer blandt andet til at:

  • Skrive og tilpasse indhold til sociale medier, websites, CRM, annoncer, landing pages og trykte materialer
  • Omsætte kreative briefs og idéer til færdige tekster og content klar til publicering
  • Lokalisere internationale kampagner til det danske marked
  • Lave lettere billed- og videoredigering og indimellem producere enkelt foto- og videoindhold
  • Kvalitetssikre tekster, links, filer og assets inden levering
  • Arbejde struktureret med versionsstyring og deadlines
  • Følge udviklingen på sociale medier og dele relevante trends og indsigter med teamet.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Skriver dansk på modersmålsniveau
  • Har mindst tre års erfaring med contentproduktion, eksempelvis som Content Writer, Content Creator, Copy writer eller Social Media Editor
  • Skriver sikkert på tværs af forskellige kanaler og målgrupper
  • Kan omsætte kreative oplæg til færdigt indhold med høj kvalitet
  • Har erfaring med værktøjer som Photoshop, Canva, Figma eller Premiere Pro
  • Har god forståelse for sociale medieplatforme og digitale formater
  • Arbejder naturligt med AI-værktøjer til research, idéudvikling og produktion
  • Er flydende på engelsk.

Hvem er du?

Du elsker godt sprog og har en skarp fornemmelse for, hvordan budskaber skal formuleres, så de virker. Du arbejder struktureret, trives med mange opgaver og tager ansvar for kvaliteten hele vejen til den endelige levering. Du er nysgerrig, samarbejdsorienteret og motiveres af at skabe indhold, som både ser godt ud og skaber effekt.

Hvem er vi?

T&P er et globalt kreativt bureau og mediebureau bygget på The Power of &. I Norden er vi omkring 40 medarbejdere fordelt på København, Stockholm, Helsinki og Oslo. Vi kombinerer kreativitet, teknologi og media for at skabe vækst for vores kunder så som Toyota, Lexus og Clarins.

Som en del af WPP får du det bedste fra to verdener: styrken fra et globalt netværk og kulturen fra et agilt nordisk bureau.

T&P er en arbejdsplads med lige muligheder. Vi vurderer alle kandidater ud fra deres kompetencer og arbejder aktivt for en inkluderende kultur, hvor alle har mulighed for at udvikle sig.

And trust, transparency, and human interaction are more important than ever as open source ideals and corporate agendas are weirdly attacked, limited, or promoted by unexpected sources and trends.

Today, we are seeking a leader who can help us become more present and trusted than ever before in this space, both as the storage default for agent-led projects and as a leading source of support, inspiration, and enablement for developers who need storage for whatever they’re building.

As Sr. Developer Relations Manager, you'll work across a strong set of existing assets — a mature docs team, an engineering team focused on AI ecosystem integrations, our Flamethrower Startup Program, a content org, and an outward-facing SE team — and coordinate their outputs into a coherent, credible developer presence that earns mindshare where it matters most.

This is a program-defining role for someone who thinks in systems, works backwards from adoption goals, knows how to make a company technically credible with developers who haven't heard of it yet, and is comfortable both channeling and being the face of developer relationships at Backblaze.

 

What You'll Own

Developer Presence in the Agentic Stack

The primary goal of this role is to ensure Backblaze B2 is the best storage layer for developers and for their agents. That means understanding how AI coders discover and evaluate infrastructure tools today: through MCP servers, coding agent contexts, reference architectures, SDKs, and machine-readable documentation. You'll work with the internal AI team to define what "agent-ready" means for Backblaze and drive execution against it across engineering, docs, and content.

Your job is to coordinate these teams around a unified developer strategy, keep that strategy moving, and share its outputs with the broader world.

 

Community and Ecosystem

Developers trust other developers. You'll underscore Backblaze's credibility in the communities where AI builders live: GitHub, Discord, open source projects, developer events, and the growing ecosystem of AI infrastructure tooling. You'll elevate internal technical voices, use their expertise to build your own thought leadership in the space, and partner with ecosystem players, and show up in a way that is earned, not marketed. Critically, you should have a presence in this community before coming to the role.

 

Developer Feedback Loop

You'll maintain a tight feedback loop from the developer community back to product and engineering — surfacing adoption friction, unmet integration needs, and emerging patterns worth prioritizing. The Flamethrower Startup Program gives you direct access to early-stage builders who can serve as signal-rich canaries for what's working and what isn't.

 

Metrics and Program Accountability

You'll define what success looks like — developer signups, activation rates, B2 adoption in AI frameworks, community engagement, content reach — and own progress against it. We're building this program to drive real revenue, and you'll be expected to connect the dots between awareness and conversion. What We're Looking For

Description:
Developer Engagement Lead

Reports to: Head of Developer Growth · New York, NY

NOTE: This is not a traditional social media or community management role. It’s a developer growth role that sits within the Product org.

Developers are already talking about Datadog - on Reddit, Discord, Hacker News, GitHub, X, LinkedIn, YouTube, forums, and places we probably haven’t found yet.

We’re hiring a Developer Engagement Lead to make sure we’re part of those conversations.

You’ll own how Datadog listens, responds, and participates across developer channels. That means running our existing developer social accounts, building our presence in new communities, creating the monitoring and response systems that help us find relevant conversations quickly, and connecting developers with the right people inside Datadog.

This is a builder role. We’re not looking for someone to manage a content calendar or simply moderate a community. We want someone who can build the operating model for developer engagement at scale.

What you'll own

  • Build our developer listening and engagement system. Create the tooling and workflows to monitor conversations about Datadog, our products, our competitors, and the problems developers are trying to solve across Reddit, Hacker News, Discord, GitHub, X, LinkedIn, Stack Overflow, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.
  • Turn monitoring into action. Build a process for identifying conversations worth joining, determining when Datadog should respond, and routing questions or feedback to the right engineer, PM, DevRel, support, or product expert.
  • Own our developer channels. Run @datadogdevs on X and Datadog Developers on LinkedIn, including publishing, engagement, replies, and experimentation.
  • Expand where Datadog participates. Establish and grow our presence in places where developers already spend time. That may include launching Discord, creating a stronger Reddit strategy, building participation models for Hacker News or GitHub, or identifying entirely new channels.
  • Make Datadog more responsive. Define response guidelines, escalation paths, ownership models, and expectations so developer conversations don’t disappear into screenshots and Slack threads.
  • Participate directly. Know when to respond as Datadog, when to pull in an expert, when an engineer should answer under their own name, and when the best response is simply to listen.
  • Create feedback loops into Product. Surface recurring questions, pain points, objections, competitive mentions, product feedback, and emerging developer conversations to Product, Engineering, Developer Growth, and other relevant teams.
  • Get more technical voices into the conversation. Make it easy for Datadog engineers, PMs, researchers, and other experts to participate directly in developer conversations instead of relying exclusively on brand accounts.
  • Turn shipped work into conversations. Find compelling ways to bring releases, changelogs, technical content, demos, events, and engineering work into the places developers are already talking.
  • Build measurement that matters. Define how we measure developer engagement beyond follower counts and impressions. Track things like conversations joined, response coverage, sentiment and recurring themes, participation from technical teams, traffic, product discovery, trials, and signups.
  • Run experiments. Test new platforms, formats, tooling, workflows, response models, and engagement programs with a clear hypothesis and readout. Keep what works and move quickly past what doesn’t.

Who you are

You understand how developers behave online. 

You’ve built an audience, community, engagement program, developer program, or similar function, and can point to outcomes you changed.

You have strong judgment about when a company should join a conversation and when it shouldn’t.

You are naturally curious. If developers suddenly start discussing something relevant to Datadog, your instinct is to understand why, find the thread, and figure out whether we should participate.

This is a hard distributed-systems and platform problem, not a tooling procurement exercise. AI-driven development lifecycle (AI-DLC)

Cloud-based agentic development infrastructure

  • Build and own the platform that runs agentic development in the cloud: on-demand, reproducible, isolated workspaces provisioned per task, with the right source, dependencies, secrets, and services already in place.
  • Design for concurrency and safety — sandboxed execution, least-privilege credentials, network egress controls, and blast-radius limits so many agents can run against real codebases without becoming a security or reliability incident.
  • Make agent runs fast and cheap: warm environment pools, caching and snapshotting, incremental builds, and test selection so a cloud agent loop is measured in minutes, not tens of minutes.
  • Own the orchestration and control plane — queueing, scheduling, autoscaling on Kubernetes, session lifecycle, artifact and log retention, and observability into what agents did and why.
  • Own unit economics. Instrument per-task and per-agent cost, set budgets and quotas, and keep the platform financially sustainable as usage scales across the org.
  • Build the human interface layer: how engineers dispatch work to cloud agents, monitor fleets of concurrent runs, review and merge results, and intervene when a run goes sideways.

Developer experience

Developer infrastructure and engineering velocity

  • Partner with quality and release engineering to shift quality left without slowing teams down.

Leadership

  • Lead a multi-team organization as a manager of managers, hiring and developing engineering managers and senior/staff-plus ICs.
  • Run an org distributed across North American and Asian time zones with genuine care for handoffs, overlap hours, on-call fairness, and inclusion — not just calendar math.

Description:
About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role:

AI Dev Tools builds the platform Gusto engineers use to work with AI, not just alongside it: agentic coding environments (local and cloud), automated AI code review, and the CI/security infrastructure underneath both. In this role, you'll own that platform end-to-end from the product bet (what should an agent be trusted to do autonomously, and when) to the infrastructure underneath it (CI systems, sandboxing, vendor contracts) to the team building it.

This is not a traditional "developer productivity" management role. You'll be making judgment calls on agent autonomy and security posture, negotiating infrastructure vendor contracts, and setting the AI-spend guardrails your own team operates under in addition to the standard Engineering Manager work of growing and unblocking a team of senior engineers.

About the Team:

AI Dev Tools builds Gusto's agentic coding platform: tooling infrastructure, agent runtimes, AI code reviews, The team also owns the security work required to run AI workloads safely in the cloud, like queue isolation, permission scoping.

The team partners constantly with Infra, Security, and Legal (on vendor contracts and AI risk posture), and reports on strategy directly to Gusto's CTO.

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

  • Own the agentic coding roadmap. Set direction for interactive and autonomous agent modes, entry points (Slack, web, CLI), and the orchestration model for multi-step/multi-repo agent work.
  • Agentic code review. Own its accuracy/coverage roadmap, and make the real tradeoff calls between review quality, PR merge speed, and per-review inference cost — backed by data, not vibes.
  • Set the security and risk posture for autonomous coding agents at Gusto. Decide what an agent can do unsupervised, own the sandboxing/permission-scoping model, and drive the underlying hardening (runtime isolation, secrets handling, blast-radius containment) needed to run agent workloads safely.
  • Set and enforce AI infrastructure spend guardrails for your team, translating raw usage data into judgment calls about what's legitimate cost of doing the job vs. what needs a conversation.
  • Lead and grow a team of senior engineers working across ambiguous, fast-moving problem spaces — recruit, mentor, run the hiring loop, and make calibration/leveling calls you can defend.
  • Be a direct strategic partner to engineering leadership (including the CTO) on where AI-native software development is heading at Gusto, grounded in what's actually shippable, not vendor hype.

Here’s what we're looking for:

  • 8+ years of engineering people leadership experience, including managing senior engineers through ambiguous, rapidly-changing technical problems (not just well-scoped roadmap execution)
  • Direct, hands-on experience with agentic coding tools — you are a daily power user of Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or equivalent, not someone who has read about them
  • Experience owning a significant vendor or infrastructure contract from technical requirements through legal and procurement close
  • Comfort making autonomy/risk tradeoff calls on AI systems without a dedicated security team making the call for you — you understand the shape of the risk (e.g., prompt injection, credential exposure, permission bypass) well enough to scope it yourself
  • Track record of leading through ambiguity across more than one nominally separate problem domain at once
  • Strong, direct communication — evidenced by briefing senior/executive stakeholders on strategy (not just status) and getting real decisions out of those conversations
  • Self-driven mindset, comfortable in Gusto's PE model: your job is removing roadblocks and setting direction, not command-and-control management

Our cash compensation amount for this role is targeted at $240,000-260,000 in Denver & most remote locations, and $290,000-305,000 for San Francisco & New York. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.

At Gusto, we don't use titles the traditional way, as a signal of rank or hierarchy. Instead, our titles describe two things at once — your craft (what you do, e.g. Engineering, Design) and your scope of ownership (what you're accountable for) — which is why you'll see something like "Head of X" instead of a rank word like "Director" that tells you neither. Because of this, the title on this posting may look different from what you'd expect based on the scope and seniority of the role, and from how similar roles are typically titled elsewhere. If you have questions about how this role compares to your current title or level, your recruiter can help translate.

Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale.

Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas. 

When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees.
