Klaviyo's operational infrastructure, built and managed by our GTM Systems team, powers our GTM engine. We're looking for a Senior GTM Architect, a technical expert with end-to-end understanding of the systems behind marketing, sales, and customer experience, who can reimagine how that system works with an AI-first approach, and who is hands-on enough to build, ship, and de-risk the hardest parts.

About the team

Our GTM Systems team sits at the center of Klaviyo's GTM engine, powering the operational infrastructure that connects marketing, sales, partnerships, and customer success. We build and own the systems that enable our teams to move quickly, trust their data, and focus on what matters most: helping our customers grow. As we scale, we're rebuilding the marketing, sales, and CX stack around agentic AI as the operating model, not a bolt-on experiment.

About the role

As the Senior GTM Architect, you are the domain expert for how Klaviyo's marketing, sales, and customer experience systems work together and how they should work differently once AI agents, not just dashboards and workflows, are doing meaningful parts of the job. You own the architecture across our CRM (Salesforce), marketing automation, sales engagement, data enrichment, and CS/support platforms. You translate ambiguous GTM strategy into system architecture (data models, integration patterns, agentic workflows), drive the roadmap by looking around the corner with GTM leadership, and stay hands-on to build and ship meaningful parts of the solution yourself, not just diagram it from a distance.

Because of the breadth of this remit, you'll regularly present architecture decisions and AI transformation strategy directly to senior GTM, RevOps, and executive leadership, and need to influence outcomes well above your reporting line.

How you'll make an impact

  • Own end-to-end GTM systems architecture: Salesforce, marketing automation, sales engagement, data enrichment, and CS/support platforms, ensuring seamless integration and clean, bidirectional data flow across marketing, sales, and customer success.
  • Ship AI agents into production, not pilots: build and deploy agentic workflows replacing manual GTM work with intelligent, auditable automation.
  • Redesign core GTM processes around AI: lead-to-revenue, opportunity management, renewals/expansion, and support handoffs, evaluating and piloting AI-native tools rather than just administering the existing stack.
  • Stay hands-on: architect and ship meaningful pieces of the solution yourself (Apex, LWC, SOQL, integrations, AI orchestration layers), track your work transparently, and set the technical bar through code review and pairing.
  • Establish data quality and governance standards that keep GTM data trustworthy at scale, and build the reporting infrastructure that leadership relies on to make decisions.
  • Serve as the go-to domain expert and trusted advisor to Marketing, Sales, RevOps, CX, and senior/executive leadership translating complex architectural and AI tradeoffs into language that drives decisions in the room, not just documentation after the fact.
  • Mentor engineers and GTM Systems teammates on system design, AI-native workflow design, and technical tradeoff thinking.

What makes you a great fit

  • You've been the technical decision-maker for a complex, multi-system GTM platform (Salesforce or similar) spanning more than one function: marketing, sales, and/or customer success. You are  able to both design the architecture and build meaningful parts of it yourself, hands-on with Apex, LWC, Flow, and integrations.
  • You have hands-on experience designing and building agentic AI/LLM-powered workflows for real business problems, and a clear, defensible point of view on where AI should replace human judgment in GTM workflows and where it shouldn't.
  • You can translate ambiguous, cross-functional business problems (marketing, sales, CX, revenue operations) into a technical solution and a clear set of tradeoffs, then explain your reasoning to engineers and business stakeholders alike.
  • You operate with a high degree of autonomy and influence: given a fuzzy, high-visibility problem, you can drive it from discovery through design through delivery, and you're comfortable being the person senior and executive leadership turns to for a straight answer.
  • You have a track record of raising the bar for a team's engineering practice through code review, GitHub-based workflows, and technical mentorship,  even when you're the most senior technical voice in the room.

Nice to haves

  • Salesforce Application Architect, System Architect, or similar architect-track certification (or equivalent demonstrated experience).
  • Hands-on experience with LLM/agent frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, Agentforce, or similar) and deploying them into production environments.
  • Experience with the broader GTM tooling ecosystem, conversation intelligence (Gong), marketing automation (HubSpot), customer success (Gainsight) and data enrichment (ZoomInfo/Clearbit/Clay) and how each integrates with a CRM.
  • Familiarity with vector databases and RAG patterns for grounding AI agents in GTM and CRM knowledge.
  • Experience at a high-growth software company supporting marketing, sales, and CX systems together not just a single function.

Why this role matters at Klaviyo

This is not a purely strategic, diagrams-only architect role. Klaviyo's GTM Systems function is actively shifting its engineering standard toward pro-code, GitHub-based development and AI-assisted, agentic workflows across marketing, sales, and CX. You'll both set that direction and help build it. Here's what makes it worth your time:

  • Your architecture decisions and your code directly affect how Klaviyo generates, converts, and retains revenue  you own enough of both the design and the build to know it holds up.
  • You'll have a broader canvas than a single-function systems role: marketing, sales, and CX are yours to architect as one system, not three.
  • You'll help define what an AI-first GTM operating model looks like at Klaviyo establishing standards and practices that outlast any single sprint, and that leadership adopts because you made the case.

Role Overview

AI is rapidly changing how software is designed, built, tested, reviewed, deployed, and operated — and the industry playbook is being rewritten monthly. Okta's Developer Productivity and AI Enablement Engineering teams own building and operating the capabilities that make our engineers fast across the inner and outer development loops. This role is the product counterpart, embedded full-time with that organization, that makes those investments compound by uncovering and prioritizing frictions, bringing the outside in, driving standardize-vs-federate decisions, spreading what works across teams, funding and clearing the path for the best tools, and proving the value.

We are looking for a Staff Product Manager to own developer productivity as a product across Okta's development lifecycle — AI-native and traditional tooling alike. You will start bottom-up: interviewing engineers, managers, tech leads, and architects; mapping current inner- and outer-loop tooling and the frictions; and baselining dev-cycle metrics. From there, you will own the roadmap with engineering leadership; benchmark how the best engineering organizations build with AI; define tooling requirements and/or run the tooling evaluations engineering needs in a landscape that changes monthly; find the teams inside Okta getting outsized results and turn their patterns into playbooks; lead build, buy, integrate, and standardize decisions, including the vision for reducing implementation diversity across Okta and Auth0; clear the security, legal, procurement, and budget paths that slow adoption; and own the measurement that connects investment to engineering outcomes — evidence engineering leaders can take into any room.

This is a highly technical internal platform role that creates value for Okta through a cross-team, cross-industry, cross-functional layer that turns individual wins into organizational capability.

What You'll Do

  • Product Strategy & Discovery: Own the vision, PRDs, and prioritized backlog for Okta's internal developer productivity and AI tooling. Treat engineers as your customers: start with deep, bottom-up discovery (dozens of engineer, EM, tech lead, and architect interviews), baseline dev-cycle metrics, and secure tooling budgets with rigorous, ROI-driven business cases.
  • Ecosystem Validation (Build vs. Buy): Drive definitive "adopt, build, or pass" decisions.   • Hands-On Execution: Embed full-time with Developer Productivity Engineering and own the roadmap jointly with its engineering leads. Define MVP scopes, manage sprints, and incrementally ship workflows. You own the strategy and requirements (the what and why); Engineering owns the technical execution (the how).
  • Adoption & Outcomes: Own org-wide adoption, clearing security, legal, and privacy hurdles along the way. Measure success by connecting tool usage directly to hard engineering outcomes (cycle time, quality, toil reduction).
  • Standardization & Lighthouses: Coordinate the vision for reducing implementation diversity across Okta and Auth0 engineering. Study high-performing teams to see who is getting exceptional results, and convert those patterns into scalable playbooks that shift the broader org from passive AI use to agentic workflows.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience with developer platforms, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, or AI products.
  • Experience owning internal or platform products where users have alternatives — adoption driven through product quality rather than mandate.
  • Strong understanding of modern software development workflows — source control, IDEs, CI/CD, testing, code review, observability, production operations — across the inner and outer loops of development.
  • Hands-on, current fluency with AI-assisted software development — coding agents, context management, MCP, evaluation frameworks — and informed views on where these tools create leverage and where they introduce risk.
  • Demonstrated ability to design and run technology evaluations and controlled experiments, and to define measurement systems for developer productivity with judgment about their failure modes.
  • Ability to engage credibly in technical and architectural discussions with senior engineers while maintaining clear boundaries between product outcomes and engineering implementation.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across engineering, security, architecture, and finance without direct authority.
  • Excellent written communication in a docs-first culture; you can produce solid action plans from incomplete, conflicting, or ambiguous inputs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience deploying or scaling developer tools across a large, multi-org engineering organization — including consolidating divergent stacks and the change management that comes with it.
  • Hands-on familiarity with developer AI tools, harnesses, APIs, MCPs, and agent orchestration frameworks.
  • Familiarity with developer productivity research (DORA, SPACE, DX Core 4) and its failure modes.
  • Experience establishing governance, evaluation frameworks, or spend management for rapidly evolving, consumption-priced technologies.

Why This Role Matters

AI-assisted development is becoming both one of the largest levers on engineering velocity and one of the largest new variable costs in R&D. The playbook changes monthly, and the organizations that win are the ones that learn fastest from the outside, spread what works internally, and measure honestly. That learning-and-leverage layer doesn't build itself — engineering teams optimizing locally, however well, still leave organizational value uncaptured and accumulate divergent implementations that slow everyone down.

This role exists to capture it: dedicated product leadership that brings engineering the external intelligence, funded tooling, cleared paths, shared patterns, and defensible evidence to build with AI faster than any single team could alone — while deepening Okta's firsthand credibility as the company that secures the AI-powered enterprise for its customers.

About the Role

Tailscale is looking for an experienced Manager, Developer Relations Engineering to lead a team of technical builders who help developers discover, understand, adopt, and build with Tailscale. You will be accountable for turning Tailscale’s technology into compelling developer experiences—from integrations and example applications to demos, tutorials, open-source projects, and technical content—that drive meaningful developer and business outcomes.

This is a player-coach engineering leadership role that combines team leadership with hands-on technical execution. You’ll lead Tailscale’s Developer Relations Engineering team while continuing to build yourself: developing integrations, demos, example applications, technical prototypes, workshops, and educational experiences that show developers what is possible with Tailscale. You’ll help the team identify the highest-leverage developer problems to solve and turn successful experiments into repeatable programs.

This role partners closely with Product, Engineering, Growth, Content, Sales, Customer Success, and the broader Marketing team. You’ll maintain a clear technical roadmap for the team, surface developer friction and emerging use cases back into the product organization, and build the systems and measurement practices needed to understand which DevRel investments are driving adoption.

We’re looking for someone with strong engineering and technical credibility, excellent product judgment, and a track record of turning developer insight into technical experiences and projects that make complex products easier to understand and adopt.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Tailscale’s Developer Relations Engineering team and roadmap, translating company, product, and developer priorities into a focused set of technical projects and programs.
  • Manage and develop a high-performing team of Developer Relations Engineers. Set clear expectations, give team members meaningful technical ownership, provide strong coaching and feedback, and help both senior and developing talent increase their impact.
  • Lead the team in building high-quality technical experiences including integrations, example applications, open-source projects, demos, workshops, reference architectures, tutorials, and other developer tooling that helps developers quickly understand what they can build with Tailscale.

  • Serve as a visible technical voice for Tailscale through hands-on work such as videos, presentations, demos, integrations, workshops, and community engagement. 
  • Ensure DevRel eng work is technically accurate, engaging, relevant to its intended audience, and aligned with current product positioning
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Growth, Content, Sales, and Customer Success to coordinate launches, educational initiatives, and developer feedback. Influence product strategy by identifying developer workflows and ecosystem opportunities where Tailscale can create differentiated value, and work with Product and Engineering leaders to validate and prioritize those opportunities. Act as the senior DevRel partner for major launches and strategic bets.
  • Define, track, and regularly report on DevRel eng performance, including audience growth, engagement, product activation, integration adoption, and contribution to the self-serve funnel
  • Use qualitative developer insight and performance data to prioritize programs, improve execution, and demonstrate the value of DevRel eng investments

What We Are Looking For

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in Developer Relations, developer advocacy, engineering, or a related field
  • 2+ years of experience managing, coaching, or leading technical contributors and scaling a DevRel or similar function. 
  • Strong software engineering foundation. You should be comfortable writing and reviewing production-quality code, working with APIs and developer tooling, debugging technical problems, and getting hands-on with unfamiliar technologies.
  • Experience building developer-facing technical projects such as integrations, SDK examples, reference applications, open-source tools, demos, workshops, or developer infrastructure—and taking them from idea through launch and iteration.
  • Ability to translate product and company priorities into a focused technical roadmap for a small team, and to make thoughtful trade-offs between experimentation, developer education, integrations, and other projects.
  • Strong program management skills, including planning, prioritization, delegation, and proactive risk communication
  • Strong developer-product instincts and the ability to recognize where developers are getting stuck, what will create an “aha” moment, and whether the right solution is a product change, integration, tool, example, tutorial, or explanation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and engagingly
  • Experience with and joy for collaborating cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Growth, Sales, or Customer Success teams
  • Ability to balance hands-on execution with team leadership and long-term program development
  • Experience working in public codebases and developer ecosystems, including comfort with GitHub workflows, pull requests, issue discussions, technical feedback, and collaborating with external developers.
  • Experience defining and reporting on DevRel eng metrics, program performance, or contribution to product and business outcomes
  • Comfortable operating in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment and creating clarity through direct communication and documented plans
  • Low ego, high horsepower with a “yes, and” mindset to collaboration
  • You have tried and used Tailscale

Nice to Have

  • Experience leading DevRel for a developer-focused infrastructure, networking, security, or open-source product
  • Deep familiarity with Tailscale, WireGuard, networking concepts, identity-based access, or Zero Trust architecture
  • Experience supporting product-led growth or self-serve adoption
  • Experience building technical integrations, example applications, community tools, or open-source projects
  • Established experience speaking at conferences, hosting technical videos, or facilitating developer workshops
  • Experience developing new public-facing technical voices within a team or company
  • Familiarity with measuring developer journeys from content engagement through signup, activation, and paid conversion
  • Experience managing agency partners, contractors, program budgets, or external contributors
  • Experience working in a fast-paced startup or scale-up environment

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

The role

We're looking for a Social Media and Content Marketing Manager to own the channels where Flexport shows up every day. You'll run our social presence, keep the blog full of content people actually want to read, and produce a newsletter that logistics leaders look forward to opening. You'll write most of it yourself, polish the visuals in Canva, cut short videos for social, and build a network of voices, inside Flexport and out, who amplify our story.

This is a hands-on job for a strong writer who gets social, has an eye for design, and likes shipping work rather than just planning it.

You will

  • Own Flexport's owned social channels day to day across LinkedIn, Twitter/X, YouTube, Facebook, and Instagram: plan the calendar, write the posts, publish, engage, and report on what's working.
  • Write and edit blog content that turns complex supply chain topics into pieces people finish and share, from thought leadership to customer stories to product updates.
  • Produce our newsletter end to end, from picking the stories to writing the copy to hitting send.
  • Design social graphics and light marketing assets in Canva, staying true to Flexport's brand.
  • Edit short-form video for social, including cutting clips, adding captions, and packaging them for each platform.
  • Build our influencer network on both sides: coach internal experts and executives to post with confidence, and cultivate relationships with external creators and industry voices.
  • Track performance across channels and use what you learn to make the next post, article, and newsletter better.

You should have

  • 5+ years in social media, content marketing, or a closely related role.
  • Genuinely strong writing. You can take a dense logistics topic and make it clear, sharp, and worth reading.
  • Hands-on experience managing owned media channels, including LinkedIn, Twitter/X, YouTube, Facebook, and Instagram.
  • A working command of social best practices across those platforms, from what to post to when and why, and how each channel differs.
  • Basic design editing skills. You're comfortable building clean, on-brand graphics in Canva.
  • Basic video editing skills. You can cut and caption short clips for social without needing a full production team.
  • Comfort managing several channels and deadlines at once, with the ownership to keep them all moving.
  • Bonus: experience building creator or influencer programs, or working in B2B, logistics, or tech.

Description: Our mission is clear and staggeringly important: we're building the manufacturing operating system of the future from the ground up, one that’s engineered to create network effects as we grow. A beautiful, sophisticated quantum leap forward for the most important core industry in the world. Manufacturing is important. It’s the fundamental industry on which everything else is built. We take it for granted. In 1989, 35% of the entire software industry was manufacturing systems. What was the first massive burst in productivity from technology has stagnated into diminishing returns and increasing complexity. We can only continue to add complexity for so much longer until the whole system collapses. "Any intelligent fool can make things bigger and more complex. It takes a touch of genius and a lot of courage to move in the opposite direction." - Albert Einstein Who you are You have good taste and strong creative instincts You know the difference between content that's good enough and content that's genuinely great You can take complex, technical concepts, and turn them into clear, compelling stories You work autonomously, manage multiple projects at once, and don’t require constant direction to move fast You’re energized by execution, you love shipping work fast and creating momentum You’re curious and constantly experimenting, especially with AI tools to help you work smarter and faster You are comfortable talking to customers, asking thoughtful questions, and pulling out insights You enjoy collaborating with people across different functions and personalities You're open to feedback and constantly looking to improve your craft You have 3-7 years of experience in this type of role What the job is This role sits at the intersection of content marketing and product marketing. We have deep customer knowledge, strong product expertise, and a growing library of stories worth telling. Your job is to package that knowledge, bring it to life, and get it in front of the customers who need to hear it. You'll: Work with customers and internal subject matter experts to surface stories worth telling Drive product launches with content, messaging, visuals, and positioning Produce and edit video content for social media, product launches, customer stories, and campaigns Plan, edit, and publish podcast episodes end to end Build landing pages, web content, and digital experiences that bring leads into the pipeline Organize and maintain Fulcrum's content library so assets are findable and reusable Leverage AI tools to optimize the way you work with content creation, editing, production, research, and distribution Continuously test new formats, channels, and creative approaches Help maintain and evolve Fulcrum's brand across all customer-facing touchpoints Travel onsite to meet, interview, and watch how customers operate to gain a deeper understanding Who you'll work with Marketing Leadership : you'll get direct access to strategic coaching, honest feedback, and support for your growth and development Product Team : you'll collaborate closely on messaging, positioning, and how we bring new features and launches to market Design Team: you'll partner on maintaining a consistent, high-quality brand across every customer touchpoint Sales Team : you'll stay close to the field, trading insights on messaging, customer feedback, and what's resonating in the market Why this role is different This isn't a role where you'll spend months debating positioning frameworks or sitting in planning meetings. We already have the content, the customer knowledge, and the product expertise. What we need is someone who can package it, amplify it, and get it in front of the right people. One week, you might be filming a customer story on the shop floor. The next you're launching a podcast episode, redesigning a webpage, building a product launch campaign, or turning a customer visit into twenty pieces of content. You'll have the freedom to experiment, create, and make a visible impact on how Fulcrum grows. Salary + Benefits $110,000 - $135,000 yearly Equity 401(k) matching after 90 days - immediate vesting Health, dental, and vision benefits Wellbeing benefits and perks Unlimited vacation policy with minimum required vacation days Cell phone & internet plan coverage This role is open to candidates located in the U.S. and authorized to work here. We’re not able to offer visa sponsorship at this time. The market tells us we’re on the right track: +50% year over year growth but we know to not rest on our laurels and that there's a lot of stuff to build and a huge amount of work to be done. We're looking for people who can stand alongside us and work hard to make our dreams become reality in the fastest, smoothest, and best way possible. If you're someone who is obsessed with making amazing things, being the best, and wanting your work to contribute to something excellent, please reach out.

Description:
DESCRIPTION

Content at quip is a growth engine, not a cost center. quip is at an inflection point, and content is one of the sharpest levers we have. We are hiring a Director of Content to build and run the machine that turns content into revenue — across every place a customer discovers, considers, and buys quip.

This role is about architecting and executing a content strategy that moves the topline: driving consideration, breaking through platform algorithms at scale, and converting attention into sales across every channel quip sells through. Critically, that includes retail. This leader should be as obsessed with driving customers into Target, Walmart, and the shelf as with any online sale — content is how quip wins the aisle, not just the feed. If you think about content the way a growth operator thinks about a P&L, this is your seat.

This is a hybrid role based in our DUMBO, Brooklyn office two days per week. 

Base Salary: $175k to $195k

This range represents anticipated base salary range for this position, in addition to competitive benefits and equity (as applicable). We carefully assess and consider several factors with each candidate, including location, role-related knowledge, experience and skills. Compensation may vary based on these considerations.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

  • Content as a business driver as a measurable growth lever with real revenue contribution across every channel — DTC, retail, and marketplaces — not an output count or a vanity reach number.
  • Retail as a first-class outcome — using content to drive consideration and demand that converts at the shelf (Target, Walmart, and beyond). This leader is obsessed with driving customers to retail as much as to any online channel, and works hand-in-glove with the Head of Sales (who owns quip’s retail accounts) to make content pull product through the aisle.
  • A high-velocity content engine — an always-on, high-cadence content operation producing breakthrough volume every week and month across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.
  • The Brand — the positioning, identity, and voice that make quip distinct in a crowded category — driving consideration, pricing power, and loyalty, and showing up consistently everywhere a customer meets us. 
  • Content-first commerce — TikTok Shop, live/social selling, and emerging content-driven marketplaces (e.g., Whatnot), building the content that sells — in lockstep with the Head of E-commerce, who owns channel conversion and the e-commerce P&L.
  • The connective tissue between creative, design, and content — so brand expression and performance work as one system, not three silos.
  • Content capability across the org — coaching teams, agencies, and creators to think and produce like a modern content company.
  • Community & influencers — establish and oversee an always-on creator/influencer engine and an owned community that compounds reach and advocacy over time, feeding the content machine and lowering the cost of every impression — not transactional, one-off sponsorships.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Define and execute a content strategy tied to explicit topline growth targets across all sales touchpoints — DTC, retail, and marketplaces — from top-of-funnel consideration through to sale.
  • Own brand integration end to end, and be its chief custodian — one coherent quip across product, marketing, retail, and e-commerce. 
  • Treat retail as a primary destination, not an afterthought: build content that drives consideration and foot traffic to Target, Walmart, and other retail partners, and that pulls product off the shelf. Partner closely with the Head of Sales to connect content to retail sell-through.
  • Stand up a repeatable, high-volume content operation — in-house studio, creators, UGC, and agency partners — that consistently breaks through the algorithms rather than chasing them.
  • Own platform strategy and native fluency across TikTok, Instagram (Reels), and YouTube (Shorts and long-form), Pinterest, and test emerging platforms early and cheaply.
  • Drive content-led commerce on TikTok Shop and live/social selling; partner tightly with E-commerce to convert attention into transactions.
  • Move fluidly between “creative,” “design,” and “content” to raise the efficacy of every marketing dollar, including the creative that fuels paid and lifecycle.
  • Manage and scale a highly functioning team across content, design, community and influencers/partnerships
  • Build measurement that connects content to consideration, engagement, and revenue — and kill what does not work, fast.
  • Inspire and upskill the wider organization so content becomes a muscle everyone builds, not a function that sits in a corner.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 10+ years building content, social, and creative for consumer brands, with a clear track record of content that drove growth — not just impressions.
  • Demonstrated experience building “content machines”: high-volume, always-on production systems across the social and digital landscape.
  • Deep, current, hands-on command of TikTok, Pinterest, Instagram, and YouTube and how their algorithms actually reward content — you know what breaks through because you have made it break through.
  • Real, practical understanding of TikTok Shop and content-first selling platforms (Whatnot, live commerce). You have sold through content, not just posted it.
  • Fluency across creative direction, design sensibility, and content production — you can mirror all three to drive marketing efficacy.
  • An omnichannel instinct: you have used content to drive not only online sales but retail demand and sell-through, and you treat the shelf as a channel you are accountable to.
  • A revenue-first operating mindset and genuine comfort being measured on business outcomes.
  • Player-coach leadership: you build teams and capability, and you can still get into the work when it matters.
  • NYC-based, in-market, and hands-on.

HOW WE WILL MEASURE SUCCESS

  • Content’s contribution to topline growth across every channel — DTC, retail, and marketplaces — from consideration through to sale.
  • Demand and sell-through driven into retail (Target, Walmart, and partners), not just online conversion.
  • Volume and breakthrough: consistent high-cadence output that wins reach and engagement against the algorithms.
  • Content-driven commerce revenue (TikTok Shop / live selling).
  • Efficiency lift delivered to paid acquisition and lifecycle through stronger creative.
  • Organizational capability: a content muscle visibly built across teams.

Benefits:

  • Hybrid working environment, with an office located in the heart of DUMBO with breathtaking views of Manhattan Bridge
  • Year round early “summer Fridays”
  • WiFi enabled rooftop
  • Competitive medical benefit package
  • Commuter benefits for parking & transit
  • Competitive paid parental leave policy for qualifying employees
  • Open vacation policy
  • Dog-friendly office space
  • 401k Tax Benefits
  • Competitive compensation package
  • Fully stocked kitchen with snacks (make sure to use your quip after snacking!)
  • Your very own quip with employee discount packages
  • The opportunity to help us make oral care more simple, effective and accessible!

About quip

quip is a design-led oral health and wellness company on a mission to transform oral care from a "have-to" chore into a "want-to" ritual. Launched in 2015, we provide effective, simple and well-designed oral health products with electric toothbrushing at the center. Our award-winning product lineup includes sonic and oscillating toothbrushes, smart brushes that track habits, water flossers, and refillable essentials like floss, and whitening strips. Our products are available for subscription on our site as well as on Amazon, in most major retailers and for sale to Dental Offices.

quip empowers millions of users to take proactive control of their oral health. We believe that by combining science-backed design with intuitive technology, we can guide a lifetime of better habits for every mouth. At quip, we work as one team, stay agile, bring positive energy to everything we do, and play to win for our customers and each other.

quip is committed to promoting equality, inclusion, and diversity beyond your brushing routine. We believe our company is better equipped to care for every mouth when we listen to fresh perspectives from every voice, and in doing so, we build an equal-opportunity team of the brightest minds (and mouths)—regardless of race, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, identity, or any other trait that makes you you. By celebrating and supporting our differences, we will thrive in our mission to improve oral health for all.

Description:
About Taskrabbit:

Taskrabbit is a marketplace platform that conveniently connects people with Taskers to handle everyday home to-do’s, such as furniture assembly, handyman work, moving help, and much more.

At Taskrabbit, we want to transform lives one task at a time. As a company we celebrate innovation, inclusion and hard work. Our culture is collaborative, pragmatic, and fast-paced. We’re looking for talented, entrepreneurially minded and data-driven people who also have a passion for helping people do what they love. Together with IKEA, we’re creating more opportunities for people to earn a consistent, meaningful income on their own terms by building lasting relationships with clients in communities around the world.

Taskrabbit is a hybrid company with employees distributed across the US and EU and a Built In — Best Places to Work (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025) continually ranked across multiple national and regional categories. Join us at Taskrabbit, where your work will be meaningful, your ideas valued, and your potential unleashed!

This role operates on a hybrid schedule requiring two days of in-office collaboration per week. The position can be based in either our San Francisco office (Financial District) or our new New York City office (NoMad).

 

About the Role

We are looking for a Sr. Manager, Brand & Content to help build and scale Taskrabbit’s brand and content engine. This role will play a critical part in shaping how Taskrabbit shows up to clients, Taskers, partners marketing across channels, translating our brand platform into a cohesive, always-on content system that drives awareness, engagement, and long-term demand.

This is more than a traditional content role. You will define what we say, how often we show up, and how our narrative comes to life across marketing channels. You will work cross-functionally with Creative, PR, Social, Growth, CRM, SEO, and regional teams to ensure we are delivering consistent, high-quality storytelling that resonates with our audiences and supports business growth. 

This role sits at the center of Taskrabbit’s next phase of growth. As we invest in building a scalable brand and a cross-channel content engine, this person will help define how we show up in the world—ensuring we are not just driving demand, but building a brand customers recognize, trust, and choose over time.

Responsibilities

Own the Content Strategy & Narrative

  • Develop and evolve Taskrabbit’s global content strategy and editorial calendar, anchored in brand positioning, key service category insights, and life moments
  • Define clear content pillars, including tone, proof-point hierarchy, and "when to lead with what" guidelines, that balance functional authority with emotional storytelling
  • Translate the brand platform into a scalable content system across channels, audiences, and target demographics 
  • Ensure content is consistent, connected, and reinforcing a unified narrative

Build the Messaging Architecture and Manage a Cross-Channel Content Engine

  • Translate brand positioning into a full messaging hierarchy including core narrative, category-level proof points, audience-specific value props (Client vs. Tasker vs. Partner, by category and life moment) so all teams are pulling from the same architecture
  • Own the message map as a living document; as new categories, markets, or partnerships (IKEA, Wayfair) come online, extend the architecture for teams to leverage 
  • Partner with channel leads to adapt content for platform-specific formats and audiences, maintaining always-on content programming 
  • Partner with SEO/AEO teams to align content strategy with high-intent search and AI discovery opportunities; ensure content supports both human engagement and structured, search-friendly formats

Champion the Brand through Campaign Development

  • Develop and manage end-to-end process for larger campaigns and brand moments
  • Generate campaign concepts: bring point-of-view ideas to Brand Marketing and Creative leadership rooted in cultural moments, category insights, or customer triggers
  • Prototype and pitch multiple campaign directions per quarter (a hook, a proof point, a channel plan), shortening the gap between "we should say something about X" and an executable brief

Partner with Creative to Scale Production

  • Work closely with Creative to brief and develop content formats that can scale (video, social, editorial, etc.)
  • Help define repeatable formats and systems that enable high-quality, high-volume output
  • Contribute to evolving AI-enabled creative workflows to increase efficiency and speed

Measurement and Optimization

  • Define success metrics for content strategy and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, scale what works, and evolve what doesn’t
  • Analyze performance across channels and continuously refine content strategy based on insights and evolving business needs

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in content strategy, brand marketing, or editorial roles
  • Strong strategic thinker with the ability to translate brand positioning into actionable content systems
  • Experience managing cross-channel content (social, video, CRM, PR, or editorial)
  • Proven ability to build and scale content programs, not just execute campaigns
  • Deep understanding of how content performs across platforms (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, etc.)
  • Experience working cross-functionally with creative, growth, and product teams
  • Strong storytelling instincts with a balance of creative taste and analytical rigor
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment and building new systems from the ground up
  • Experience building messaging architecture / message maps that multiple teams can consistently execute against 
  • A track record of originating campaign ideas (not just briefing them); can point to concepts they conceived and got greenlit
  • Quick thinker who is comfortable presenting rough concepts to leadership and iterating in the room

Desired Skills & Experience

  • Experience in marketplace, consumer tech, or home/lifestyle brands
  • Familiarity with SEO/AEO and content for search and AI-driven discovery
  • Experience working with creators or influencer programs
  • Exposure to AI tools for content development and production
  • Proficient with Asana or other project management tools

Compensation & Benefits: 

At Taskrabbit, our approach to compensation is designed to be competitive, transparent, and equitable. Total compensation consists of base pay + bonus + benefits + perks.

The base pay range for this position is $142,000 - $189,000. This range is representative of base pay only, and does not include any other total cash compensation amounts, such as company bonus or benefits. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed above and will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, qualifications, geography, and level.

You’ll love working here because:

  • Taskrabbit is a Hybrid Company. We value flexibility and choice but also stay committed to regular in-person connection.
  • The People. You will be surrounded by some of the most talented, supportive, smart, and kind leaders and teams -- people you can be proud to work with!
  • The Diverse Culture. We believe that we make better decisions when our workforce reflects the diversity of the communities in which we operate. Women make up half of our leadership team and our diversity representation is above that of the tech industry average.
  • The Perks. Taskrabbit offers our employees with employer-paid health insurance and a 401k match with immediate vesting for our US based employees. We offer all of our global employees generous and flexible time off with 2 company-wide closure weeks, Taskrabbit product stipends, wellness + productivity + education stipends, IKEA discounts, reproductive health support, and more. Benefits vary by country of employment. 

Taskrabbit’s commitment to Diversity and Inclusion:

An Active Commitment to Equity within our Company and Platform. We are an inclusive community where all who share our mission and values belong. Our diverse team represents the communities we serve, breaking down systemic barriers, and transforming lives- one action at a time.

Taskrabbit is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military/veteran status, or disability status. Description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About the Role

Verkada runs over 500 events a year across various formats and sizes.  Whether it is our multi thousand attendee annual user conference, VerkadaOne, or more intimate roundtables, today the marketing team custom builds a lot of the programming and content ahead of each event. 

As our first Field Marketing Content Manager, you will own the content, programming and templatization behind all of them. You will create and build templatized, reusable content systems so every event ships faster and at consistent quality, and integrate it with our quarterly global campaigns so that we build a more seamless journey for our partners, end-customers and prospects. Every session, agenda, and asset you produce should incorporate the pre, during and post motions required to successfully move prospects further along the funnel. 

You will have the support of a separate event logistics team but will completely own the content and programming end to end, along with how it plugs into the broader integrated campaign motion.

We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role requires that you be on-site at our office in San Mateo, CA 5 days a week.

What You'll Do

  • Create and templatize our annual user conference, VerkadaOne. Create templatized content frameworks (agendas, session formats, web copy, email tracks, brochures, and internal promotion kits) that scale across VerkadaOne, VerkadaOne on-the-road events, large Verkada-hosted Security Summits, and more intimate event experiences. 
  • Integrate in-person first and third party events into our integrated campaigns Partner with campaign owners to connect field program content to the campaigns running around it: pre-event acquisition, in-event engagement, and post-event follow-up that turns attendees into pipeline.
  • Own agenda and programming. Design event agendas, manage content schedules, and coordinate programming so every component supports the event's goals.
  • Own event web and registration content. Develop messaging for event websites and keep it current as speakers, sessions, and details are announced.
  • Curate breakout sessions. Develop session content for distinct attendee groups: customers, prospects, and partners.
  • Extend conference content regionally. Adapt VerkadaOne content into regionalized events that run throughout the year.
  • Drive event communications. Own email messaging, event branding touchpoints, and the internal content that gets our field teams promoting each program.
  • Build out longform event-related content. Own the creation and production of branded brochures that describe the event, speakers, and agenda.
  • Repurpose recorded content. Curate recorded sessions (and other events content) and update Verkada’s web properties for post-event reuse.

What You Bring

  • 5–8 years of experience in content development, integrated marketing, product marketing or event content for large-scale programs.
  • Mastery of the English language, with the ability to communicate clearly and effectively across diverse content formats
  • A systems mindset: you build templates and repeatable processes, not one-off deliverables.
  • Strong content generation skills across web pages, slides, email and other formats, backed by a clear grasp of content strategy.
  • Excellent project management: you can run multiple concurrent programs, work cross-functionally, and manage budget and demand generation activities.
  • Strong interpersonal skills; you manage diverse stakeholders with tact and professionalism.
  • A self-starter mentality with hands-on execution experience.
  • Ability to work onsite in San Mateo, CA, five days a week, with flexibility to travel for regional events.
  • Bachelors Degree required.

Employee Benefits

US Employee Benefits

Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:

  • Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs - Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans
  • Nationwide medical, vision and dental coverage
  • Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with tax saving options
  • Expanded mental health support
  • Paid parental leave policy & fertility benefits
  • Time off to relax and recharge through our paid holidays, firmwide extended holidays, flexible PTO and personal sick time
  • Professional development stipend
  • Wellness/fitness benefits
  • Healthy lunches provided daily
  • Commuter benefits

Additional Information

  • You must be independently authorized to work in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this role, at this time.

Annual Pay Range

At Verkada, we want to attract and retain the best employees, and compensate them in a way that appropriately and fairly values their individual contribution to the company. With that in mind, we carefully consider a number of factors to determine the appropriate starting pay for an employee, including their primary work location and an assessment of a candidate's skills and experience, as well as market demands and internal parity. A Verkada employee may be eligible for additional forms of compensation, depending on their role, including sales incentives, discretionary bonuses, and/or equity in the company in the form of restricted stock units (RSUs)

Description:
At Bondora, our mission is simple: to make finance easy, transparent, and accessible for everyone.

Founded in 2008, we’ve helped more than 700,000 customers across Europe borrow and invest effortlessly through our trusted digital products.

As a rapidly growing financial technology company, we’re reaching new heights with a bold vision. We’re set to acquire a banking license, unlocking a world of possibilities for our customers. This transition will allow us to expand our lending across more EU countries and broaden our product suite to deliver even more value.

Join us on this journey and let’s build the future of finance together!

What is this role about?

As the Senior Social & Content Manager, you´ll lead social end-to-end across our markets, own the editorial calendar and content distribution engine, and run the creator program. You´ll partner with Brand & Creative, Product Marketing, Performance, and Country teams to make content a measurable lever for demand generation at Bondora.

Role: Assistant Communications Content Manager

Location: Birmingham, United Kingdom 

About the role: 

Working within Client's Customer Communications Centre of Excellence, you'll own the content development process end-to-end: shaping briefs, writing and editing communications, managing approvals and maintaining clear audit trails. You'll sit within a multidisciplinary squad and work in close partnership with an Assistant Communications Delivery Manager — you lead on content strategy and approval; they lead on technical build and implementation. Together, you'll stay jointly focused on delivering the right customer outcome.

This is a mid-senior specialist role with no direct reports, but with real influence. What you will be doing: 

  • Create and improve customer communications across email, letters, SMS and digital messaging — producing clear, accurate, well-structured copy that reflects Client's brand standards and best-practice principles.
  • Shape briefs from the outset, working with stakeholders and squads to agree the right communication approach, balancing customer needs, channel capabilities and delivery timescales.
  • Manage the end-to-end content development process — from brief to approval — ensuring all communications meet governance, regulatory, risk and assurance requirements, with complete records and approvals in place.
  • Apply Consumer Duty principles to every piece of content, making sure communications are fair, accessible and explicit about what customers need to do next.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify content, reduce avoidable communications and make better use of digital channels, while maintaining or improving customer outcomes.
  • Partner with product, proposition and service teams to connect communications to the wider customer journey and Client's strategic priorities.
  • Use internal insight and external market knowledge to improve communication effectiveness and identify opportunities to innovate.
  • Contribute to planning, prioritisation, delivery and continuous improvement as part of a multidisciplinary, cross-functional squad.
  • Build trusted relationships with internal stakeholders, agencies and suppliers to support clear accountability and high-quality delivery.
  • Champion high standards within the Centre of Excellence — share knowledge, embed consistent ways of working and help raise practice across teams. 

What you need to be great in this role: 

  • Experience in communications, marketing, CRM, digital or customer servicing, creating, updating or governing customer-facing content to a high standard.
  • Strong writing and editing skills — you produce clear, concise, customer-friendly copy and adapt tone, structure and calls to action for different owned channels.
  • Sound knowledge of email, print, SMS and digital messaging — including accessibility requirements, content hierarchy, character limits and call-to-action design.
  • A customer-first mindset: a genuine commitment to clarity, fairness and reducing customer effort.
  • Confident stakeholder skills — you ask thoughtful questions, challenge constructively and translate complex business requirements into effective communication outcomes.
  • Sound judgement and strong attention to detail: you balance customer needs, brand standards, risk requirements and delivery timescales without compromising quality.
  • Familiarity with governance, regulatory or risk frameworks in a regulated environment — financial services experience is an advantage.
  • A continuous-improvement mindset — curious about customer insight, market developments and new ways to improve content and channels.
  • Comfortable working in multidisciplinary teams, with the ability to build effective relationships across functions and with external partners.
  • Proficiency with Gen AI tools relevant to content and communications work to enhance output quality and efficiency.
  • Experience developing personal AI workflows that improve consistency and turnaround.
  • Agentic approach to content development and problem-solving — able to break down complex briefs and identify efficient paths forward.
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI outputs and apply human judgement — essential in a regulated financial services environment.

About Tripadvisor 

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

Tripadvisor is looking for a Content Manager for our Spanish market to develop outstanding, culturally-aligned experiences for a global audience. As a key representative of our users, you will ensure that our content fosters trust, resonates with local audiences, and increases conversion. You will be the bridge between global product vision and local cultural reality.

This is a high-impact role where you will directly contribute to our business growth by improving user engagement and brand perception in one of our most important markets. You will be part of the Localization team and you will work with product, marketing, analytics, research, engineering, and design teams to influence every aspect of content creation. Job Location: Hybrid

This role is a hybrid position that requires 2 days per week in our London office.

What You'll Do

  • Craft, Adapt & Refine: Localize, write, edit, and transcreate clear, culturally-relevant, compelling content across all user-facing touchpoints. You’ll own the voice of your market, ensuring content is resonant, persuasive, and local-first.

  • Shape the Content Strategy: Partner with product managers, UX designers, SEO, vendors, and researchers to define and execute content strategies for high-priority product features, from initial concept to launch.

  • AI-native localization: manage LLM-driven workflows, help design prompts, and leverage machine translation to protect quality, maximize efficiency, and scale content volumes.

  • Think as a user: Act as the voice of the traveller. You’ll synthesize local user research and market trends to challenge global assumptions and advocate for local user needs.

  • Drive impact through testing: Initiate and support A/B tests on localized content to measure the impact on conversion, engagement, and traffic to inform content strategies.

  • Collaborate and Iterate: Work seamlessly with cross-functional teams to ensure content is integrated into the design and development process from the beginning. Provide regular feedback to your global colleagues and contribute to a unified content strategy.

  • Own and Maintain Quality: Ensure all content adheres to Tripadvisor Group’s brands voice and tone while feeling completely natural to local users. Partner with translation vendors to create, maintain and optimize all  linguistic assets for your market.

  • Champion usability: Operate within a continuous QA mentality to keep the UX fresh and relevant. Proactively identify and fix content-related issues in our product, making data-driven, user-centric recommendations for improvements.

What We're Looking For

  • Native-level fluency and cultural authority: A deep, intuitive understanding of the language, culture, and user behaviour in your market.

  • 5+ years of experience: You worked in a localization, UX writing, transcreation, translation, content design, or related role within a global ecommerce or tech company. Experience in the travel industry is a significant plus.

  • Open-minded, innovative approach: You use AI as an enabler and you have a curious, forward-thinking mind. You are comfortable experimenting with technology to automate the repetitive so you can focus on the creative.

  • Excellent  command of localization practices: You master foundational internationalization and localization principles. You have 3+ years experience of working with translation management systems and you have familiarity with linguistic quality assurance frameworks (MQM or similar).

  • A solid understanding of UX content methodologies: You are comfortable working with design tools (e.g., Figma, Miro), analyzing user research, and using data to inform your decisions.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills: You build strong, collaborative relationships with cross-functional colleagues, using data and user insights to demonstrate how localized content strategy serves as a primary engine for global growth.

Skills & Experience 

  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making in day-to-day work.
  • Proven ability to operate effectively with a global-first mindset 

What We Offer 

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars:

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us. 

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges. 

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

Description:
Company Summary

Zoro.com is a leading eCommerce platform offering nearly 12 million tools, parts and supplies for our business customers. Launched in 2011, we brought a B2C-like experience to the B2B industry, and continue to be at the forefront of digital innovation at the intersection of technology and distribution. We have rapidly grown to over $1 billion in annual revenue and we’re just getting started!

Job Summary: 

Understanding our customers and delivering content that resonates with them is fundamental to the success of our business. The Customer Content Strategy Manager will coordinate the creation and execution of customer-aligned content and messaging strategies. This role is responsible for translating customer strategy into clear messaging hierarchies, defining content priorities by segment, and developing guidance for creative storytelling through vignettes and campaign assets.

 

Duties and Responsibilities: 

  • Lead the development and alignment of customer messaging hierarchies across all segments, defining the most impactful content and messaging at each stage of the customer journey
  • Develop strategic creative briefs that translate customer insights into clear messaging frameworks, content structures, and creative direction to drive consistent, targeted communication across channels
  • Own and maintain a segment-driven content calendar, ensuring alignment with overarching content strategy across digital channels and web platforms
  • Partner cross-functionally with creative and campaign teams to ensure execution is aligned with strategic intent and delivers cohesive storytelling
  • Collaborate cross functionally with analytics teams to evaluate content performance, translating insights into actionable recommendations that continuously enhance the customer experience

Minimum Qualifications: 

  • 4+ years of experience with marketing planning/strategy
  • Bachelor's degree or related professional experience
  • Demonstrated strategic thinking skills with a proven ability to develop, articulate, and execute effective strategies that drive business outcomes
  • Ability to measure performance and translate data into actionable objectives
  • Experience collaborating across various teams such as Creative Services, Analytics, Merchandising, and Execution teams
  • Strong collaboration, communication, and organizational skills
  • Ability to project manage/prioritize multiple projects simultaneously
  • Self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment

Total Rewards

Zoro’s total compensation plan includes our Zoro Incentive Plan (ZIP) that is designed to foster and reward our team members for strong performance. Total compensation will be highly competitive.

In addition to competitive compensation, Zoro offers comprehensive benefits and perks including:

  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans with coverage starting on day one of employment
  • Maternity support programs, nursing benefits, and up to 14 weeks paid leave for birth parents and up to 4 weeks paid leave for non-birth parents. We also support growing your family through access to adoption assistance program
  • 6 free sessions each year with a licensed therapist and Wellhub portal membership to support your mental and emotional wellbeing
  • At least 18 paid time off days annually for full-time employees and 6 company holidays per year
  • 6% company contribution to a 401K Retirement Savings Plan each pay period, no employee contribution required
  • Tuition reimbursement, student loan refinancing and access to financial counseling, education, and tools
  • Charitable Gift Program - match gift to an eligible educational, cultural, community health, and human service organizations
  • Employee discounts and admission to various civic and cultural institutions around Chicago
  • Zoro office perks including coffee bar, beer on tap, unlimited snacks, access to the onsite gym, and incredible city skyline views

Our Culture

Zoro was founded in 2011 with a simple idea: make it easy for businesses to get the tools, parts, and supplies they need to keep things running. We've grown by staying curious, moving quickly, and solving everyday challenges in smart, practical ways. Backed by W.W. Grainger and inspired by our endless assortment business model, we’re on a clear path toward our next big milestone: $2 billion in revenue—and beyond.

At Zoro, we don’t just follow a playbook—we help build it. You’ll get to work on real problems with a supportive team that shares ideas freely, learns from each other, and celebrates wins together. Our culture is grounded in values that guide how we show up every day: Winning & Learning Together, Being Customer Obsessed, Being Transparent, and Taking Ownership. We don’t have all the answers, but we’re always asking good questions.

Zoro’s culture has been recognized by Fortune, Best Places to Work, and Built In Chicago—but the recognition we care about most comes from our team members, who make this place what it is.

We also know that flexibility matters. Our hybrid work model gives you space to focus and the flexibility to live your life — asking team members to be onsite at least two days a week. Our Chicago HQ (right above Ogilvie Transportation Center in the Accenture Tower) is always open and ready for connection, collaboration, or just a good cup of coffee.

At Zoro, we’re growing fast toward big aspirations — and we’re continuously excited about the new challenges we get to solve together.

About Stripe

Description:
About Black Forest Labs

We're the team behind Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX—foundational technologies that changed how the world creates images and video. We’re creating the generative models that power how people make images and video—tools used by millions of creators, developers, and businesses worldwide. Our FLUX models are among the most advanced in the world, and we're just getting started.

Headquartered in Freiburg, Germany with a growing presence in San Francisco, we're scaling fast while staying true to what makes us different: research excellence, open science, and building technology that expands human creativity.

Why This Role

Our research team moves fast. Models improve weekly. New capabilities emerge constantly.

What slows us down is not model quality—it’s productionization.

Without this role:

  • Research checkpoints sit longer before becoming usable APIs

  • Inference is slower than it needs to be

  • APIs struggle under load

  • Demos don’t reflect the true potential of our models

This role removes the bottleneck between frontier research and production reality. Once hired, researchers ship faster, demos launch faster, and customers experience models at their best.

What You’ll Work On

You will own the bridge between research breakthroughs and production systems.

  • Turn research checkpoints into production-ready inference services

  • Design and maintain high-performance APIs serving millions of requests

  • Optimize inference latency and throughput across GPU infrastructure

  • Build scalable serving architectures that handle unpredictable traffic

  • Improve reliability, monitoring, and observability across model-serving systems

  • Prototype and ship demos that showcase new capabilities in days, not weeks

  • Collaborate closely with researchers to move from idea to live endpoint rapidly

Tools & Context – Model Serving & API Infrastructure

  • Python, FastAPI, async systems

  • GPU infrastructure, CUDA, inference optimization

  • Docker and Kubernetes

  • Redis, Postgres, distributed task queues

  • Cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

  • Observability stacks (metrics, logging, tracing)

This role spans backend systems, GPU performance, and production ML serving.

What We’re Looking For

You’ve built and operated systems at meaningful scale. You understand the difference between a research prototype and a production system. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, making tradeoffs, and improving systems under real-world constraints.

You demonstrate:

  • Strong judgment around performance, reliability, and cost tradeoffs

  • Experience scaling APIs or ML systems under load

  • Comfort working in fast-moving, research-adjacent environments

  • Ownership from system design through debugging and deployment

Role-specific experience we value:

  • Building and operating ML inference services in production

  • Designing scalable API architectures with async processing

  • Optimizing GPU workloads (batching, quantization, compilation, CUDA)

  • Managing distributed systems and task queues under variable load

  • Implementing monitoring and observability for production ML systems

  • Debugging performance bottlenecks across model, infrastructure, and network layers

Bonus experience includes:

  • Real-time or low-latency inference systems

  • TensorRT, reduced precision, layer fusion, or model compilation techniques

  • Frontend demo tooling (Streamlit, Gradio, React)

  • CI/CD and automated testing for ML systems

  • Security best practices for API and model serving

How We Work Together

We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. Depending on your role, you’ll either join us in Freiburg or SF at least 2 days a week (or one full week every other week), or work remotely with a monthly in-person week to stay connected. We’ll cover reasonable travel costs to make this possible. We think in-person time matters, and we’ve structured things to make it accessible to all. We’ll discuss what this will look like for the role during our interview process.

Everything we do is grounded in four values:

  • Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.
  • Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.
  • Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.
  • Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.

Base Annual Salary: $180,000–$300,000 USD

We're based in Europe and value depth over noise, collaboration over hero culture, and honest technical conversations over hype. Our models have been downloaded hundreds of millions of times, but we're still a ~50-person team learning what's possible at the edge of generative AI.
